jobs.title: Director, Google Gemini Enterprise - Data & AI
jobs.description:
Overview

At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can build momentum that reaches beyond our business, develop skills for the future, and take ownership of your career with support at every stage. Join a firm where your career can make a difference.

Are you a talented leader with a proven track record for motivating teams and delivering exceptional client service?

Our Data & AI team is one of our fastest‑growing practices, with strong client demand across sectors to modernize data platforms and operationalize AI. We are seeking a highly experienced AI consulting leader to drive the growth and delivery of Google Gemini Enterprise–based solutions across our client base. This role sits at the intersection of technology, strategy, and commercial execution, helping organizations unlock value from generative AI and agentic workflows.

You will lead end-to-end client engagements, from shaping AI strategy through to delivering enterprise-scale implementations, while collaborating closely with Google Cloud to co-develop solutions and accelerate joint go-to-market initiatives.

What You Will Do

Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders (CIO, CTO, CDO, CFO), guiding AI-driven transformation agendas
Lead AI strategy engagements, including maturity assessments, Gemini Enterprise roadmaps, and operating model & governance design
Translate complex business challenges into clear AI-enabled opportunities and value cases
Architect end-to-end Gemini Enterprise solutions, covering data integration & grounding, agentic workflows, and security/compliance frameworks
Provide technical oversight across data, AI/ML, and cloud engineering teams to ensure cohesive delivery
Advise on scalable deployment models and enterprise integration (ERP, CRM, collaboration platforms)
Lead large-scale AI programs from pilot through enterprise rollout, ensuring quality, timelines, and value realization
Develop reusable assets and accelerators (use cases, reference architectures, deployment playbooks) to scale delivery
Build and manage strategic relationships with Google Cloud, aligning client needs with product roadmap evolution
Co-develop joint solutions and go-to-market offerings with partners and contribute to capability development
Support business development and complex pursuits, including solution shaping, proposals, and pricing models
Present Gemini Enterprise solutions to executive audiences, translating technical concepts into clear business narratives
Drive client-facing storytelling on agentic AI, productivity gains, and ROI realization
Contribute to firm thought leadership and market positioning in AI transformation

What You Bring To The Role

10+ years in consulting, technology, or AI/data leadership roles
Proven track record delivering enterprise AI or cloud transformation programs
Expertise in enterprise AI architecture and design
Strong expertise in generative AI/LLMs, enterprise data architecture, and cloud platforms (GCP preferred)
Experience engaging and influencing C-suite stakeholders
Ability to shape, position, and close complex deals
Demonstrated success contributing to business development and revenue growth
Experience with Google Cloud ecosystem and strategic alliances
Exposure to AI agents/agentic workflows and enterprise AI governance frameworks
Track record building repeatable consulting offerings and intellectual property

KPMG Ontario Region Pay Range Information

The expected base salary range for this position is $147,000 to $192,000 and may be eligible for bonus awards. The determination of an applicant’s base salary within this range is based on the individual’s location, skills & competencies, and unique qualifications. In addition, KPMG offers a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards program.

Providing you with the support you need to be at your best

Our Values, The KPMG Way

Integrity
, we do what is right | Excellence
, we never stop learning and improving | Courage
, we think and act boldly | Together
, we respect each other and draw strength from our differences | For Better
, we do what matters

KPMG in Canada is a proud equal opportunities employer and we are committed to creating a respectful, inclusive and barrier-free workplace that allows all of our people to reach their full potential. A diverse workforce is key to our success and we believe in bringing your whole self to work. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply and hope you will choose KPMG in Canada as your employer of choice.

Adjustments and accommodations throughout the recruitment process

At KPMG, we are committed to fostering an inclusive recruitment process where all candidates can be themselves and excel. We aim to provide a positive experience and are prepared to offer adjustments or accommodations to help you perform at your best. Adjustments (informal requests), such as extra preparation time or the option for micro breaks during interviews, and accommodations (formal requests), such as accessible communication supports or technology aids, are tailored to individual needs and role requirements. You will have an opportunity to request an adjustment or accommodation at any point throughout the recruitment process. If you require support, please contact KPMG’s Employee Relations Service team by calling 1-888-466-4778.

AI Usage

We embrace the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance the candidate experience and streamline our recruitment processes. AI tools may help with organizing applications or surfacing relevant qualifications. However, no hiring decisions are made using AI. Every hiring decision is made by our hiring managers and recruitment professionals, who are equipped with training that empowers them to use these tools responsibly. AI technologies used in our recruitment process undergo detailed risk assessments, including security and privacy requirements, that align with KPMG’s Trusted AI framework.

We believe technology should empower human judgment, not replace it. It’s one of the many ways we’re delivering on our vision of being a technology-first, people-driven firm.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Data
jobs.description:
The Company

Cover Genius is the global infrastructure for embedded protection. Active in over 60 countries and all 50 US States, we protect the customers of the world’s largest digital companies, including Klarna, Revolut, Stripe, Priceline, Agoda, Booking.com, Turkish Airlines, Tongcheng Travel, eBay, and Uber, with seamless, end-to-end experiences. Cover Genius has protected more than 73M customers globally across 240M policies with USD $3.2BN in gross written sales.

Coming off a stellar year with 40% YoY revenue growth and a recent $100M capital raise, putting our valuation at $1.9BN, we are accelerating into our next phase of growth. As part of our team, you’ll help drive our AI-first roadmap, developing hyper-personalization engines, agentic distribution, and automated claims infrastructure, while building the scalable technology powering the fast-growing $70B embedded protection market.

Our people are:
Accountable, customer-obsessed, collaborative, driven

Our people are not:
Passive, defensive, siloed, hesitant

About The Role

As Senior Director of Data on our Technology team, you will own Cover Genius' data strategy end-to-end and act as domain lead for Data Products, accountable for its OKRs, roadmap, and delivery. You will work closely with our partnership teams to understand what partners need to see, and give them a clear view of how their insurance business is performing.

To drive success in this role, you will bring a genuine blend of commercial instinct, product judgement, and deep technical credibility — the breadth to lead a business domain, not just an engineering function. You will be as effective influencing at exec level, ours and our partners', as you are leading the engineers and analysts who report to you. Close collaboration with Engineering, Product, Data Science, Analytics, and our own commercial and partner-facing teams will be central to the role — ensuring data becomes a trusted, reusable foundation every other domain can build on with confidence. You will treat AI as a first-class concern of the role — building a platform that AI workloads can trust, exploring AI-enhanced partner propositions, and driving AI-assisted ways of working within your own org.

Key Responsibilities

Work closely with our commercial and partner-facing teams to understand what partners actually need and want from our data, and help shape that into offers they find compelling.
Set product direction for internal and partner-facing data products, partnering with the executive and senior leadership teams to define OKRs and roadmap, and own their execution.
Own the data platform strategy and architecture end-to-end, ensuring it keeps pace as our data grows in volume, velocity, and variety — including the data foundations that AI/ML workloads across the business depend on.
Drive adoption of the data platform across business domains, so Engineering, Data, and Product teams build their solutions on a shared data foundation.
Build governance and data-quality frameworks that make our key data assets trustworthy.
Develop a high-performing Data organisation where people love their work and grow into future leaders.

What You Will Bring

12+ years in data roles spanning platform, product and B2B partner-facing work, including 5+ years leading teams of managers and senior contributors — ideally in a regulated, high-growth B2B business.
You are comfortable working alongside commercial and partner-facing teams, can hold your own in a partner conversation, and have a track record of translating what customers want into propositions that land.
You have owned a roadmap, made hard prioritisation calls between platform investment and customer-facing delivery, and can explain the calls you got wrong.
Strong record of partnering with Engineering, Product, Data Science, Analytics and other data consumers to turn data into a trusted, reusable foundation.
Deep, hands-on architecture credibility on a modern cloud data stack — ideally GCP/BigQuery, Airflow, dbt, and data observability tooling, including experience building and operating data platforms that serve AI/ML workloads.
Proven record of establishing governance and data-quality frameworks that enable delivery rather than block it, and that are adopted across large data-centric organisations.
Practical fluency in data security and privacy in a regulated context such as insurance or financial services.

What You Will Have

Bias for action — you ship incremental improvements continuously rather than waiting for perfect conditions, act decisively, and hold a high bar for what "done" means.
Ownership without excuses — you take personal accountability for team outcomes, including the misses and talk about failures as candidly as wins.
Growth mindset — you share knowledge generously, learn from setbacks and have a track record of developing engineers and managers who go on to bigger roles.
Influence over authority — you push teams to think bigger and drive adoption of standards through credibility and clear reasoning, not mandate.
Partner and customer obsession — you're truly curious about Cover Genius' partners and trace every decision back to the customer experience or partner outcome it improves.

🤔 Why Cover Genius?

At Cover Genius, We Create Magic By Turning The Archaic Into The Extraordinary. We Take One Of The World’s Oldest And Most Complex Industries And Reinvent It With World-class Technology. Cover Genius Doesn’t Just Disrupt Legacy Insurance; We Make The Impossible Feel Effortless. Our Operating Principles Guide Our Mission

Make today matter: We deliver with urgency and excellence. We act decisively, move with intention, and hold a high bar.
Act with accountability: We own our commitments and take pride in delivering results that move us forward.
Grow together: We are a collective of curious minds. We learn from wins and setbacks, share knowledge generously, and elevate each other every day.
Inspire Each Other: We push each other to think bigger and pull together to go further.
Champion Our Customers: We lead with empathy and center the customer, turning complex disruptions into seamless moments of trust.
Flexible Work Environment - Our teams are hybrid. We work from home on a Wednesday and Thursday and attend the office on Monday, Tuesday and Friday with flexibility around start/finish times.
Don't just take our word for it - hear about our culture straight from our people here: story time.

Ready to make an impact?
If you’re looking for a place where you’ll be challenged, trusted, and empowered, we’d love to meet you.

The Legal & Privacy Stuff

Cover Genius promotes diversity and inclusivity. We don't tolerate discrimination, demeaning treatment of anyone, or harassment due to race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or any other legally protected status.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we may collect, store, and process your personal data for recruitment purposes. To ensure a fair evaluation, we may use AI to assist in sorting applications, but all final decisions are made by our hiring team and no candidate dispositions are automated. We will keep your information on file for three years from the date of your application. For detailed information about how we handle your data and our use of AI, please review our full Privacy Policy .

This position offers a base salary compensation range of C$215,000 to C$270,000 annually.

jobs.title: Chief Information Officer
jobs.description:
Putting people first, every day

BDO is a firm built on a foundation of positive relationships with our people and our clients. Each day, our professionals provide exceptional service, helping clients with advice and insight they can trust. In turn, we offer an award-winning environment that fosters a people-first culture with a high priority on your personal and professional growth.

Your Opportunity

The Chief Information Officer (CIO)
is responsible for establishing and executing the firm's enterprise technology strategy, ensuring technology capabilities enable business growth, operational excellence, security, and an exceptional people experience.

Reporting to the Chief Digital & Technology Officer, the CIO partners closely with Managing Partners, business leaders, and C-suite colleagues to align technology investments and services with strategic priorities. The CIO leads enterprise technology operations, architecture, infrastructure, end-user technology services, cybersecurity enablement, vendor partnerships, and workforce planning while fostering a modern, secure, and high-performing digital workplace.

The CIO is accountable for delivering reliable, scalable, secure, and cost-effective technology services that enable our people to do their best work and support the firm's continued growth and transformation. This role requires technical depth to guide architecture, platforms, security, data, integration, and service delivery decisions, combined with the business fluency to align stakeholders around practical outcomes.

Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities:

Enterprise Technology Strategy & Business Partnership

Develop and execute a multi-year enterprise technology strategy, roadmaps, investment priorities, and operating plans aligned with firm priorities and business objectives.
Serve as a trusted advisor to the Executive Leadership Team, Managing Partners, and business leaders, translating business priorities into practical technology initiatives with measurable outcomes and clear value realization.
Anticipate emerging technology trends and assess opportunities to leverage AI, automation, cloud, and modern workplace capabilities to improve productivity, employee experience, and business performance.
Communicate technology strategy, risks, investments, and outcomes in clear business terms and represent technology leadership in executive forums, governance committees, and strategic planning discussions.

Technology Architecture, Platforms & Modernization

Provide senior technical leadership across enterprise architecture, infrastructure, applications, integration, identity, data, cloud, and solution architecture, establishing standards and decision frameworks that support secure, scalable, resilient, and maintainable solutions.
Lead technical trade-off and investment discussions across modernization, build-versus-buy decisions, platform consolidation, integration patterns, technical debt, resiliency, lifecycle management, and total cost of ownership.
Guide the evolution of cloud and hybrid platforms, enterprise integration, data platforms, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities in partnership with data, AI, security, and business leaders.
Drive modernization of infrastructure, networks, identity and access management, endpoint and collaboration platforms, monitoring, and operational tooling, supported by disciplined delivery practices such as DevSecOps, automation, observability, and continuous improvement.
Translate complex technical issues into clear business choices, risks, investment implications, and recommended actions for senior stakeholders.

Technology Operations, Digital Workplace & Resilience

Provide strategic oversight of enterprise technology operations, infrastructure, end-user services, service management, and the modern workplace, ensuring reliable, scalable, resilient, and productive technology experiences.
Establish service standards, operating metrics, and performance expectations, using employee feedback and service insights to continuously improve the technology experience.
Lead business continuity, disaster recovery, operational resiliency, and technology adoption efforts while balancing user experience, accessibility, security, scalability, and cost effectiveness.

Security, Risk, Governance & Investment

Partner closely with Information Security leadership to maintain a strong enterprise security posture while enabling business agility, ensuring technology operates within established security, privacy, risk, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
Establish and maintain effective technology governance, architecture standards, policies, controls, and risk-management practices that are measurable, auditable, and aligned with enterprise risk appetite.
Develop and manage the enterprise technology budget and strategic vendor portfolio, overseeing sourcing, contract negotiations, performance, and investment decisions to maximize business value, service quality, and cost effectiveness.

People & Organizational Leadership

Build, lead, and develop a high-performing technology organization focused on service excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Attract, develop, retain, and succession-plan technology talent capable of supporting current and future business needs, partnering with Human Resources on workforce planning, career development, and organizational effectiveness.
Foster an inclusive, learning-oriented culture where people are empowered to grow, collaborate, challenge thinking, and deliver meaningful outcomes.

How Do We Define Success for Your Role?

You bring BDO's strategy to life by leading with genuine care, focusing on what matters most, embracing progress over preservation, and fostering a culture where people can do more together.
You establish technology as a trusted business partner and strategic enabler, translating firm priorities into measurable technology outcomes.
You deliver a secure, resilient, reliable, and modern technology environment that supports exceptional employee and client experiences while enabling innovation and business agility.
You build a high-performing, accountable technology organization with the talent and capabilities required to support the firm's continued growth and transformation.
You maximize value from technology investments through disciplined planning and execution, strong governance, strategic partnerships, and continuous improvement.

Your Experience & Education

You are a forward-thinking, people-focused technology executive with significant experience leading enterprise technology functions within large, complex organizations.
You have a proven track record developing and executing enterprise technology strategies and leading significant modernization, transformation, operating model evolution, and organizational change.
You bring practical technical fluency across enterprise architecture, cloud and hybrid infrastructure, applications, cybersecurity, data platforms, integration, automation, identity and access management, service management, and modern workplace technologies.
You understand how AI, automation, cloud, cybersecurity, and emerging digital capabilities can be applied responsibly to improve productivity, resilience, service quality, and employee experience.
You are an exceptional communicator and business partner who can influence C-suite executives and senior leaders, translate complex technology decisions into clear business implications, and align investments to organizational priorities and measurable outcomes.
You have significant experience managing enterprise technology investments, budgets, strategic vendors, service performance, risk, governance, and operational resilience.
You bring strong leadership, talent development, and coaching capabilities, with a demonstrated ability to build inclusive, high-performing technology teams.
You are familiar with recognized technology, architecture, security, and service-management frameworks such as ITIL 4, COBIT, TOGAF, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, Zero Trust, Agile, DevSecOps, SRE, FinOps, and cloud well-architected practices.
You hold a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline. An advanced degree or relevant executive technology certification is considered an asset.
Experience within professional services, consulting, or a similarly complex, relationship-driven organization is considered a strong asset.

Why BDO?

Our people-first approach to talent has earned us a spot among Canada’s Top 100 Employers for 2026. This recognition is a milestone we’re thrilled to add to our collection of awards for both experienced and student talent experiences.

At BDO, our people experience is guided by three core pillars— Do work with genuine care, Do what matters with purpose, and Do what’s next
- shaping how we support our people, serve our clients, and grow together.

Our firm is committed to providing an environment where you can be successful in the following ways:

We enable you to engage with how we change and evolve, being a key contributor to the success and growth of BDO in Canada.
We help you become a better professional within our services, industries, and markets with extensive opportunities for learning and development.
We support your achievement of personal goals outside of the office and making an impact on your community.
We foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where your ideas are valued, and you can do your best work with genuine care and purpose
We encourage innovation and forward thinking, empowering you to embrace what’s next and help shape the future of our firm

Giving back adds up:
Where company meets community. BDO is actively involved in our communities by supporting local charity initiatives. We support staff with local and national events where you will be given the opportunity to contribute to your community.

Total rewards that matter:
We pay for performance with competitive total cash compensation that recognizes and rewards your contribution. We provide comprehensive benefits from day one, and a flexible personal time off policy. We’re committed to supporting your overall wellbeing and provide reimbursement for wellness initiatives that fit your lifestyle.

Everyone counts:
We are committed to creating a workplace where employees can participate fully, contribute meaningfully and succeed without barriers. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace defined by respect, fairness, and a true sense of belonging for everyone. We recognize and celebrate the unique experiences, identities, and perspectives that each of us bring – and that these experiences strengthen how we work together. Our commitment extends to ensuring that our application process is both inclusive and accessible. If you require accommodation to complete the application process, please contact us.

Flexibility:
All BDO personnel are expected to spend some of their time working in the office, at the client site, and virtually unless accommodations or alternative work arrangements are in place.

Our model is a blended approach designed to support the flexible needs of our people, the firm and our clients. It’s about creating work experiences that meet everyone’s needs and providing flexibility to adjust when, where and how we work to meet the expectations of our role.

Code of Conduct:
Our Code of Conduct sets clear standards for how we conduct business. It reflects our shared values and commitments and includes guiding principles to help us make ethical decisions and maintain trust with each other, our clients, and the public.

BDO may use artificial intelligence enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process. While these tools assist our teams, our use of AI does not replace human decision making, and all employment-related outcomes are made by BDO personnel.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Associate Director
jobs.description:
Machine Learning Engineer, Associate Director – AI Innovation Teams

Fitch Ratings is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join our new AI Innovation teams in Toronto—a bold initiative building the AI-powered future of financial analysis. We're not fine-tuning existing models or optimizing yesterday's algorithms. We're architecting the next generation: sophisticated agentic AI systems, intelligent automation that thinks, and ML capabilities that will redefine how credit analysis happens and how global financial markets consume insights.

This is AI's moment at Fitch, and we're moving decisively. We have executive sponsorship, significant investment, and we're establishing Toronto as our AI innovation center. As a Lead ML Engineer, you'll be a technical champion driving this transformation—building breakthrough ML systems that others will study, mentoring engineers who will become tomorrow's AI leaders, and establishing patterns that will scale across the organization. You're joining at the perfect inflection point: early enough to architect foundational decisions, resourced enough to execute boldly.

We need ML technologists who see greenfield opportunities as fuel rather than fear—whether you're an ML architect ready to design intelligent systems from first principles, an AI engineering leader who translates research breakthroughs into production reality, or a seasoned practitioner who recognizes that this moment demands courage over caution. If you're motivated by "let's prove this is possible" rather than "we need more data before we decide," this is a high-impact role where you'll spend less time justifying AI's potential and more time realizing it—alongside exceptional engineers who share your conviction that we're building something significant.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to remain deeply hands-on while operating at a senior level. You will contribute technical expertise, influence decision-making through strong engineering judgment, and partner closely with engineering leaders, product teams, and fellow engineers to deliver innovative AI solutions at scale. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct people management responsibilities

What We Offer

Ground-floor ML leadership with enterprise resources – Define the ML architecture, technical standards, and engineering practices for Fitch's AI future while having the compute, research budgets, and organizational backing that most AI startups would envy; mentor and coach fellow ML engineers while remaining deeply hands-on with the most challenging technical problems
Build breakthrough ML systems that matter – Develop net-new generative AI platforms, multi-agent orchestration systems, and intelligent automation that will process billions in credit decisions; experiment with frontier models, novel architectures, and unconventional approaches; see your ML innovations directly impact how global financial markets operate
Access to cutting-edge ML infrastructure and research – Work with the latest LLMs, fine-tune foundation models, leverage enterprise-scale GPU clusters, experiment with emerging frameworks before they're mainstream, and collaborate with academic ML researchers; substantial conference and training budgets to stay at the forefront of AI innovation
Toronto as Fitch's AI center of excellence – Join our strategic investment in Toronto—one of the world's premier AI research hubs—where you'll connect with Vector Institute researchers, attend cutting-edge ML meetups, and be part of the ecosystem that's defining the future of applied AI
Shape ML governance and standards for an organization – Establish the ML engineering practices, model governance frameworks, and AI integration patterns that will guide Fitch's AI transformation; your architectural decisions will influence how a global financial services leader approaches intelligent systems
Real production impact with sophisticated ML challenges – Build ML systems that analysts and financial professionals actually use daily; solve hard problems at the intersection of NLP, document intelligence, reasoning systems, and production-scale deployment; measure your impact in both model performance and business outcomes
Accelerated career trajectory in AI leadership – High visibility to C-suite executives making billion-dollar strategic decisions; clear advancement paths to Principal ML Architect or AI Research Lead roles; opportunity to establish yourself as a recognized voice in financial AI and earn a reputation that opens doors across the industry

We'll Count On You To

Build transformative ML systems from the ground up – Design and architect net-new generative AI solutions, agentic workflows, and intelligent platforms using advanced ML frameworks (PyTorch, etc.), large language models, and emerging AI technologies that fundamentally change how analysts work and how Fitch operates
Drive breakthrough AI innovation and experimentation boldly – Lead exploration of generative AI, multi-agent systems, RAG architectures, model fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and other emerging ML technologies; create cutting-edge proofs-of-concept; evaluate what's transformative versus what's hype; and turn research into production-quality AI capabilities
Define ML technical vision and architecture for the future – Shape architectural decisions for ML systems, establish ML engineering standards, drive technology and framework choices, and influence how Fitch approaches intelligent platforms and AI governance across the organization
Lead through innovation, influence, and mentorship – Mentor and coach fellow ML engineers while partnering with product squads, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate ambitious AI ideas into elegant technical solutions; foster a culture of experimentation, continuous learning, and calculated risk-taking
Champion ML excellence while moving fast – Balance innovation velocity with ML engineering best practices; implement robust CI/CD pipelines for ML systems; develop scalable APIs (FastAPI, etc.) for model deployment; solve novel technical challenges at the intersection of cutting-edge AI research and production systems; and build solutions that are both breakthrough and reliable
Drive ML governance and operational excellence – Ensure adherence to AI/ML governance guidelines, monitor SLAs for AI solutions, optimize model performance and reliability, and translate complex ML concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences across distributed teams
Shape team culture and technical direction – Help define how our AI innovation teams operate, what "good" looks like for ML engineering, and how we balance exploration with delivery; model the curiosity, boldness, and technical rigor needed to succeed in a greenfield ML innovation environment

What You Need To Have

Deep ML technical expertise – 12+ years of professional experience building production AI/ML systems, with strong proficiency in Python, ML algorithms (from classical techniques to deep learning), and modern ML frameworks; proven track record of delivering advanced generative AI and ML solutions
ML architectural mastery and greenfield experience – Demonstrated experience designing scalable ML systems from scratch; deep understanding of ML system architecture, model deployment patterns, and the ability to make bold architectural decisions for AI platforms in ambiguous environments
Advanced generative AI expertise – Extensive hands-on experience developing and integrating generative AI solutions, working with large language models, building agentic systems, implementing RAG architectures, and training/fine-tuning neural networks using frameworks like PyTorch
Bachelor's degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or related field
Production ML engineering excellence – Deep understanding of ML operations, including containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/AWS EKS), cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), workflow orchestration (Airflow), automated testing for ML systems, and API development for model deployment
Technical leadership and influence – Track record of mentoring and coaching engineers, driving ML initiatives in fast-moving environments, leading through technical excellence and influence rather than authority, and building credibility through results and vision
Innovation and experimentation mindset – Demonstrated history of exploring emerging ML technologies, building AI proofs-of-concept, learning from failures, and translating cutting-edge research into production systems; comfort with ambiguity and rapid technological change
Outstanding collaboration and communication – Ability to articulate ML technical vision to diverse audiences, work effectively with product squads and business partners, translate complex AI/ML concepts for non-technical stakeholders, and bring your whole self while remaining open to others' perspectives

What Would Make You Stand Out

Cutting-edge AI research to production experience – Track record of taking breakthrough AI capabilities from research/prototype to production-scale deployment; experience supporting seamless transitions from experimentation to enterprise-grade ML systems with real users
ML thought leadership and technical strategy – History of establishing technical direction for ML initiatives, contributing to open-source ML projects, speaking at AI/ML conferences, publishing research, or writing about practical applications of emerging AI technologies
Multi-agent and agentic systems expertise – Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, agentic workflows, tool-using AI systems, or complex AI orchestration platforms that go beyond simple LLM integrations
Advanced cloud-native ML infrastructure – Deep expertise building sophisticated ML infrastructure, MLOps pipelines, model serving platforms, and cloud-native AI systems at scale; experience optimizing cost and performance of production LLM deployments
Financial services or analytical domain knowledge – Understanding of analytical workflows, credit analysis processes, regulatory requirements, financial data products, or how ML enables better financial decision-making; familiarity with credit ratings agencies is a significant advantage
Startup or innovation team experience – History of building greenfield ML products, working in fast-paced AI innovation environments, or being part of 0-to-1 ML initiatives within larger organizations where you shaped technical direction
Toronto AI/ML community connection – Active participation in Toronto's AI/ML research or engineering communities, connections to academic ML research groups, or strong interest in being part of Toronto's world-class AI ecosystem

If you're ready to build transformative ML systems with organizational backing, talented colleagues, and the resources to succeed—this is the moment to join us.

Why Fitch?

At Fitch Group, the combined power of our global perspectives is what differentiates us. Our global network of colleagues comes together to accomplish things greater than they ever could alone.

Every team member is essential to our business, and each perspective is critical to our success. We embrace a diverse culture that encourages a free exchange of ideas, guaranteeing your voice will be heard and your work will have an impact, regardless of seniority.

We are building incredible things at Fitch and we invite you to join us on our journey.

Fitch Group is a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries. Wholly owned by the Hearst Corporation, we are comprised of three main businesses: Fitch Ratings | Fitch Solutions | Fitch Learning.

jobs.title: Director Consulting, Health Technology & Transformation
jobs.description:
Position Description

Health Technology & Transformation

CGI is seeking a Director Consulting, Health Technology & Transformation to provide senior technical and health industry leadership across the Atlantic Business Unit.

As one of Canada's largest IT and business consulting services firms, CGI combines strong local client relationships with the scale, industry expertise, delivery capabilities, and intellectual property of a global organization. In this role, you will help connect the needs of Atlantic Canadian health organizations with CGI's national and global health, technology, and delivery capabilities.

Shape Health Solutions. Provide Technical Leadership. Enable Successful Transformation.

As a Director Consulting Expert Health Technology & Transformation, you will serve as a senior technical and solution advisory leader for CGI's health clients and strategic health initiatives across Atlantic Canada.

Working with Directors of Consulting Services, account leaders, architects, delivery leaders, and technology specialists, you will bring deep health sector and technical expertise to strategic client opportunities and complex transformation initiatives.

You will lead technical discovery, solution shaping, technology strategy, architecture alignment, and senior technical assurance, helping CGI convert client priorities into credible, secure, and executable solutions.

You will help clients understand how digital health platforms, enterprise applications, integration, interoperability, data, AI, cloud, cybersecurity, and automation can be applied to address their clinical, administrative, and operational priorities.

You will also help CGI develop a more cohesive health technology capability across Atlantic Canada by connecting local client needs with CGI's broader health expertise, reusable assets, delivery capabilities, intellectual property, and alliance partner solutions.

What You'll Bring

Your future duties and responsibilities

Health Technology Advisory

Serve as a senior health technology advisor to client technology leaders, digital health executives, operational leaders, clinical stakeholders, architects, and transformation teams.
Bring the appropriate technical expertise into strategic client discussions and opportunities by collaborating across CGI's account, consulting, architecture, and delivery teams.
Lead technical discovery sessions, current state assessments, architecture reviews, option analyses, and technology roadmap development.
Translate clinical, operational, administrative, and business requirements into practical technology strategies and solution approaches.
Advise clients on digital health modernization, enterprise architecture, interoperability, integration, data platforms, AI adoption, cloud transformation, cybersecurity, automation, and application modernization.
Help clients evaluate technology alternatives, dependencies, risks, implementation considerations, and total cost of ownership.
Ensure recommendations reflect healthcare delivery realities, privacy, security, clinical workflow, data governance, regulatory requirements, and organizational readiness.
Communicate complex technology considerations clearly to technical and non technical stakeholders.

Technical Opportunity Shaping

Partner with account and industry leaders to assess and shape strategic health opportunities.
Provide technical leadership during early opportunity qualification by assessing feasibility, complexity, capability requirements, delivery risks, and potential solution approaches.
Lead or support technical discovery workshops, solutioning sessions, demonstrations, proofs of concept, and architecture discussions.
Develop high level solution architectures, technology roadmaps, implementation approaches, estimates, assumptions, dependencies, and risk assessments.
Coordinate input from CGI specialists across digital health, cloud, data and AI, cybersecurity, application services, managed services, enterprise platforms, and systems integration.
Connect Atlantic Canadian opportunities with CGI capabilities, accelerators, intellectual property, case studies, delivery centres, and alliance partner technologies.
Ensure proposed solutions are technically credible, differentiated, scalable, secure, and aligned with the client environment.
Provide senior technical input into proposals, presentations, statements of work, business cases, and competitive procurements.
Participate in client presentations and procurement processes as CGI's senior health technology subject matter expert.
Help create a clear transition from opportunity shaping into detailed design, mobilization, and delivery.

Health Architecture and Solution Leadership

Provide architecture and solution leadership across complex health transformation initiatives.
Assess how individual technologies and initiatives fit within a client's enterprise architecture, digital health strategy, and long term operating model.
Guide solution teams in developing integrated architectures spanning applications, data, integration, cloud, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and user experience.
Promote interoperability, reuse, scalability, security, maintainability, and alignment with relevant health sector standards.
Provide expertise in health data exchange, integration patterns, APIs, interoperability frameworks, and standards such as HL7 and FHIR where applicable.
Support the modernization and integration of electronic medical record, electronic health record, claims, benefits, case management, scheduling, patient engagement, clinical, and administrative platforms.
Identify technical risks, architecture gaps, capability constraints, and dependencies before they affect implementation.
Help clients avoid isolated technology investments by promoting enterprise level roadmaps and sustainable architecture decisions.

Delivery Assurance and Technical Governance

Provide senior technical oversight for strategic or high risk health engagements.
Support engagement mobilization by validating solution scope, architecture, resource requirements, delivery assumptions, and technical dependencies.
Participate in architecture governance, design reviews, technical risk reviews, and executive steering discussions where appropriate.
Work with delivery leaders to ensure implementation remains aligned with the agreed solution strategy and client outcomes.
Provide escalation support for complex technical, architectural, integration, or health domain issues.
Help delivery teams navigate client technology environments, governance processes, privacy requirements, and health sector constraints.
Review significant solution changes to assess their effect on scope, risk, cost, architecture, and long term maintainability.
Capture lessons learned and reusable technical assets from health engagements.

Capability Development

Help define the health technology capabilities required to support CGI's Atlantic health strategy.
Collaborate with CGI's account, industry, and technology leaders to identify market needs, emerging technology trends, capability gaps, and areas in which CGI can differentiate.
Develop reusable health technology assets, reference architectures, assessment methods, solution patterns, demonstrations, and points of view.
Connect Atlantic teams with CGI health experts, architects, delivery centres, and technology practices across Canada and globally.
Mentor architects, consultants, and technical team members working within the health portfolio.
Help improve health industry fluency among CGI's technical teams and technology fluency among CGI's health consulting and account teams.
Support the identification and development of technical talent required for current and future health opportunities.
Represent CGI in health technology forums, industry working groups, technical conferences, and partner discussions as appropriate.
Maintain current knowledge of health technology developments, emerging standards, cybersecurity threats, platform capabilities, and industry leading practices.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

Twelve or more years of experience in health technology consulting, digital health, enterprise architecture, solution architecture, systems integration, technology transformation, or a related field.
Significant experience working within or advising the Canadian healthcare sector.
Demonstrated experience designing, shaping, or overseeing complex technology solutions in healthcare or another highly regulated environment.
Strong understanding of healthcare delivery environments and the relationship between clinical, operational, administrative, and technology requirements.
Experience leading technical discovery, architecture assessments, technology roadmaps, option analyses, and solution design activities.
Broad technical knowledge across digital health platforms, enterprise and solution architecture, systems integration and interoperability, health data and analytics, AI and intelligent automation, cloud, cybersecurity, application modernization, and enterprise platforms.
Understanding of health interoperability concepts, integration patterns, APIs, and applicable standards such as HL7 and FHIR.
Experience contributing to proposals, requests for proposal, statements of work, estimates, technical presentations, and competitive pursuits.
Ability to assess technical feasibility, solution complexity, delivery risk, architecture alignment, and capability requirements.
Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to business, clinical, operational, and executive audiences.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate across business development, account management, architecture, consulting, delivery, and technology teams.
Ability to provide technical leadership without needing to personally design or build every component of a solution.
A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Health Informatics, Health Administration, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Ability to obtain any reliability or security clearances required by CGI clients.
Willingness to travel within Atlantic Canada and elsewhere in Canada as required.

Key Assets

Experience working with a Canadian provincial health system, health authority, healthcare provider, payer, insurer, government health department, health benefits organization, or professional health association.
Experience with electronic health records, electronic medical records, health information exchange, claims and benefits platforms, clinical systems, patient engagement platforms, or digital front door solutions.
Experience modernizing complex legacy environments involving multiple vendors, platforms, integration technologies, and data sources.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud in regulated or health sector environments.
Experience with data platforms, analytics, machine learning, Generative AI, Responsible AI, and AI governance in healthcare.
Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks, architecture governance, technology portfolio management, and modernization roadmaps.
Familiarity with Canadian health information privacy, security, data residency, and information governance requirements.
Experience working with major health technology vendors, enterprise application providers, or cloud and platform partners.
Relevant certifications in enterprise architecture, cloud, cybersecurity, data, AI, project delivery, or health informatics.
A graduate degree in Health Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, Health Administration, or a related field.

jobs.title: Chief Information Officer
jobs.description:
Putting people first, every day

BDO is a firm built on a foundation of positive relationships with our people and our clients. Each day, our professionals provide exceptional service, helping clients with advice and insight they can trust. In turn, we offer an award-winning environment that fosters a people-first culture with a high priority on your personal and professional growth.

Your Opportunity

The Chief Information Officer (CIO)
is responsible for establishing and executing the firm's enterprise technology strategy, ensuring technology capabilities enable business growth, operational excellence, security, and an exceptional people experience.

Reporting to the Chief Digital & Technology Officer, the CIO partners closely with Managing Partners, business leaders, and C-suite colleagues to align technology investments and services with strategic priorities. The CIO leads enterprise technology operations, architecture, infrastructure, end-user technology services, cybersecurity enablement, vendor partnerships, and workforce planning while fostering a modern, secure, and high-performing digital workplace.

The CIO is accountable for delivering reliable, scalable, secure, and cost-effective technology services that enable our people to do their best work and support the firm's continued growth and transformation. This role requires technical depth to guide architecture, platforms, security, data, integration, and service delivery decisions, combined with the business fluency to align stakeholders around practical outcomes.

Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities:

Enterprise Technology Strategy & Business Partnership

Develop and execute a multi-year enterprise technology strategy, roadmaps, investment priorities, and operating plans aligned with firm priorities and business objectives.
Serve as a trusted advisor to the Executive Leadership Team, Managing Partners, and business leaders, translating business priorities into practical technology initiatives with measurable outcomes and clear value realization.
Anticipate emerging technology trends and assess opportunities to leverage AI, automation, cloud, and modern workplace capabilities to improve productivity, employee experience, and business performance.
Communicate technology strategy, risks, investments, and outcomes in clear business terms and represent technology leadership in executive forums, governance committees, and strategic planning discussions.

Technology Architecture, Platforms & Modernization

Provide senior technical leadership across enterprise architecture, infrastructure, applications, integration, identity, data, cloud, and solution architecture, establishing standards and decision frameworks that support secure, scalable, resilient, and maintainable solutions.
Lead technical trade-off and investment discussions across modernization, build-versus-buy decisions, platform consolidation, integration patterns, technical debt, resiliency, lifecycle management, and total cost of ownership.
Guide the evolution of cloud and hybrid platforms, enterprise integration, data platforms, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities in partnership with data, AI, security, and business leaders.
Drive modernization of infrastructure, networks, identity and access management, endpoint and collaboration platforms, monitoring, and operational tooling, supported by disciplined delivery practices such as DevSecOps, automation, observability, and continuous improvement.
Translate complex technical issues into clear business choices, risks, investment implications, and recommended actions for senior stakeholders.

Technology Operations, Digital Workplace & Resilience

Provide strategic oversight of enterprise technology operations, infrastructure, end-user services, service management, and the modern workplace, ensuring reliable, scalable, resilient, and productive technology experiences.
Establish service standards, operating metrics, and performance expectations, using employee feedback and service insights to continuously improve the technology experience.
Lead business continuity, disaster recovery, operational resiliency, and technology adoption efforts while balancing user experience, accessibility, security, scalability, and cost effectiveness.

Security, Risk, Governance & Investment

Partner closely with Information Security leadership to maintain a strong enterprise security posture while enabling business agility, ensuring technology operates within established security, privacy, risk, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
Establish and maintain effective technology governance, architecture standards, policies, controls, and risk-management practices that are measurable, auditable, and aligned with enterprise risk appetite.
Develop and manage the enterprise technology budget and strategic vendor portfolio, overseeing sourcing, contract negotiations, performance, and investment decisions to maximize business value, service quality, and cost effectiveness.

People & Organizational Leadership

Build, lead, and develop a high-performing technology organization focused on service excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Attract, develop, retain, and succession-plan technology talent capable of supporting current and future business needs, partnering with Human Resources on workforce planning, career development, and organizational effectiveness.
Foster an inclusive, learning-oriented culture where people are empowered to grow, collaborate, challenge thinking, and deliver meaningful outcomes.

How Do We Define Success for Your Role?

You bring BDO's strategy to life by leading with genuine care, focusing on what matters most, embracing progress over preservation, and fostering a culture where people can do more together.
You establish technology as a trusted business partner and strategic enabler, translating firm priorities into measurable technology outcomes.
You deliver a secure, resilient, reliable, and modern technology environment that supports exceptional employee and client experiences while enabling innovation and business agility.
You build a high-performing, accountable technology organization with the talent and capabilities required to support the firm's continued growth and transformation.
You maximize value from technology investments through disciplined planning and execution, strong governance, strategic partnerships, and continuous improvement.

Your Experience & Education

You are a forward-thinking, people-focused technology executive with significant experience leading enterprise technology functions within large, complex organizations.
You have a proven track record developing and executing enterprise technology strategies and leading significant modernization, transformation, operating model evolution, and organizational change.
You bring practical technical fluency across enterprise architecture, cloud and hybrid infrastructure, applications, cybersecurity, data platforms, integration, automation, identity and access management, service management, and modern workplace technologies.
You understand how AI, automation, cloud, cybersecurity, and emerging digital capabilities can be applied responsibly to improve productivity, resilience, service quality, and employee experience.
You are an exceptional communicator and business partner who can influence C-suite executives and senior leaders, translate complex technology decisions into clear business implications, and align investments to organizational priorities and measurable outcomes.
You have significant experience managing enterprise technology investments, budgets, strategic vendors, service performance, risk, governance, and operational resilience.
You bring strong leadership, talent development, and coaching capabilities, with a demonstrated ability to build inclusive, high-performing technology teams.
You are familiar with recognized technology, architecture, security, and service-management frameworks such as ITIL 4, COBIT, TOGAF, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, Zero Trust, Agile, DevSecOps, SRE, FinOps, and cloud well-architected practices.
You hold a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline. An advanced degree or relevant executive technology certification is considered an asset.
Experience within professional services, consulting, or a similarly complex, relationship-driven organization is considered a strong asset.

Why BDO?

Our people-first approach to talent has earned us a spot among Canada’s Top 100 Employers for 2026. This recognition is a milestone we’re thrilled to add to our collection of awards for both experienced and student talent experiences.

At BDO, our people experience is guided by three core pillars— Do work with genuine care, Do what matters with purpose, and Do what’s next
- shaping how we support our people, serve our clients, and grow together.

Our firm is committed to providing an environment where you can be successful in the following ways:

We enable you to engage with how we change and evolve, being a key contributor to the success and growth of BDO in Canada.
We help you become a better professional within our services, industries, and markets with extensive opportunities for learning and development.
We support your achievement of personal goals outside of the office and making an impact on your community.
We foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where your ideas are valued, and you can do your best work with genuine care and purpose
We encourage innovation and forward thinking, empowering you to embrace what’s next and help shape the future of our firm

Giving back adds up:
Where company meets community. BDO is actively involved in our communities by supporting local charity initiatives. We support staff with local and national events where you will be given the opportunity to contribute to your community.

Total rewards that matter:
We pay for performance with competitive total cash compensation that recognizes and rewards your contribution. We provide comprehensive benefits from day one, and a flexible personal time off policy. We’re committed to supporting your overall wellbeing and provide reimbursement for wellness initiatives that fit your lifestyle.

Everyone counts:
We are committed to creating a workplace where employees can participate fully, contribute meaningfully and succeed without barriers. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace defined by respect, fairness, and a true sense of belonging for everyone. We recognize and celebrate the unique experiences, identities, and perspectives that each of us bring – and that these experiences strengthen how we work together. Our commitment extends to ensuring that our application process is both inclusive and accessible. If you require accommodation to complete the application process, please contact us.

Flexibility:
All BDO personnel are expected to spend some of their time working in the office, at the client site, and virtually unless accommodations or alternative work arrangements are in place.

Our model is a blended approach designed to support the flexible needs of our people, the firm and our clients. It’s about creating work experiences that meet everyone’s needs and providing flexibility to adjust when, where and how we work to meet the expectations of our role.

Code of Conduct:
Our Code of Conduct sets clear standards for how we conduct business. It reflects our shared values and commitments and includes guiding principles to help us make ethical decisions and maintain trust with each other, our clients, and the public.

BDO may use artificial intelligence enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process. While these tools assist our teams, our use of AI does not replace human decision making, and all employment-related outcomes are made by BDO personnel.

You’ll join our regional planning and allocations team – the group responsible for planning and allocating product across every Direct-to-Consumer touchpoint in the region, spanning merchandise financial planning, demand planning, inventory planning, and allocations.  Together, we make sure the right product reaches the right place at the right time, balancing growth, profitability, inventory productivity, and an exceptional guest experience across Retail and eCommerce.  We’re a collaborative, curious group that partners closely across the business and takes pride in turning ambitious commercial goals into smart, data-driven plans.

If you were in the Director, Planning & Allocations – NAM role now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:

Owning the end-to-end planning strategy for Retail and eCommerce DTC across the North American region

Developing annual, seasonal, and long-range plans in alignment with company objectives

Establishing inventory, sales, margin, and productivity targets to support growth and profitability

Developing a holistic, strategic, approach to inventory throughout the product lifecycle to meet plan and minimize stock outs

Ensuring planning strategies support growth and profitability objectives

Building best-in-class planning teams across; Merchandise Financial Planning, Demand Planning and Inventory Planning.

Owning adoption and optimization of o9, our enterprise planning platform

Driving automation and exception-based planning process to improve efficiency and responsiveness

Leading planning process improvement and transformation initiatives

Developing and executing the DTC planning strategy aligned with business and regional priorities

Balancing growth, profitability, inventory productivity, and customer experience across channels

Partnering cross functionally and influencing cross-functional decision making across Merchandising, Retail Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, and Digital

Translating business priorities into actionable planning strategies and execution plans

Anticipating business risks and proactively developing mitigation plans to address

Driving organizational transformation and planning maturity, supporting organizational change and advancement of planning capabilities and process

Leveraging data-driven insights to influence business decisions and planning outcomes

Partnering with the Regional Commercial leadership team on business planning strategy, supporting key account business growth, while controlling inventory risks

Overseeing inventory forecasting, allocation, and resolution strategies across business units while ensuring alignment to regional objectives

Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:

Contributing to the creation of a regional product framework and assortment structure that guides merchant execution within retail stores, ecommerce channels and wholesale to maximize sales, profit and brand positioning

Leading the creation of differentiated product strategies by channel, region and format at scale to achieve revenue and product margin goals through product range, life cycle management and pricing

Are you our next Director, Planning & Allocations - NAM?

You have 10+ years’ experience in merchandise planning, inventory planning, or allocation

You have 5+ years experience leading managers and multi-level planning organization

You have a proven track record in developing and leading the execution of a multi-year business strategy

You have expertise in merchandise financial planning, open to buy, demand planning, inventory planning, and/or allocation & replenishment

You drive organizational excellence through continuous communication and proactive, solutions-based approaches

You can think both strategically and tactically, with a persistent attention to detail

You have strong communication and presentation skills, both verbally and in writing

You are proactive in identifying the root cause of issues and developing solutions

You remain highly flexible and adaptable when faced with ambiguity

You effectively balance autonomy and collaboration

You inspire breakthrough thinking and continuous improvement

You seek the best (sometimes not the easiest) solutions, with an unwavering commitment to do what is right

Your passion for your work is paralleled by your passion for getting outside and living it

The salary range for this role is CAD$167,000 - CAD$205,000

Most new team members join between the start and midpoint of the range, where you can contribute right away while continuing to grow your craft, your collaborations, and your impact at Arc’teryx. This range reflects market alignment and the scope of the role. Individual pay is determined by your skills, experience, and level of responsibility.

  *Eligibility for certain programs may vary by role.

All applicants, employees, and guests can expect equality of opportunity and fair treatment in alignment with our values.

Join us in creating positive change in ourselves, our communities, and the world.

Location

Brookfield Place - 181 Bay Street

Business - Energy

Brookfield Energy operates one of the world’s largest publicly traded platforms for sustainable energy. Our energy portfolio consists of hydroelectric, wind, utility-scale solar, distributed generation and storage facilities in North America, South America, Europe and Asia. Our operating capacity totals over 35,000 megawatts and our development pipeline stands at approximately 200,000 megawatts. Our portfolio of sustainable solutions assets includes our investments in Westinghouse (a leading global nuclear services business) and a utility and independent power producer with operations in the Caribbean and Latin America, as well as both operating assets and a development pipeline of carbon capture and storage capacity, agricultural renewable natural gas and materials recycling.

Brookfield Energy is the flagship listed energy company of Brookfield Asset Management, a leading global alternative asset manager with over $1 trillion of assets under management.

To learn more about the Brookfield Energy group, visit https://www.brookfield.com/about-us/capabilities/energy.

Brookfield Culture

Brookfield has a unique and dynamic culture. We seek team members who have a long-term focus and whose values align with our Attributes of a Brookfield Leader: Entrepreneurial, Collaborative and Disciplined. Brookfield is committed to the development of our people through challenging work assignments and exposure to diverse businesses.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Review quarterly and annual financial statements and reports in accordance with IFRS;
Prepares and assesses support used for the management discussion and analysis sections of the quarterly and annual reports and investor supplemental;
Leads the finance workstream relating to debt and equity security issuances initiated by the capital markets team by collaborating with internal and external stakeholders;
Assists with the annual budgeting process and ad hoc financial planning and analysis requests;

Manage the external audit process including the corporate finance team during quarterly reviews and annual external audits to meet various deadlines;
Modifies existing and/or designs new processes that maximize operational efficiency including the implementation of new technology;
Owns internal controls for the financial reporting process to meet SOX requirements;
Fulfill ad hoc projects to assist with information requests, including for senior management and rating agencies;
Commitment to the development of the finance team through coaching and opportunities to promote an environment of continuous learning.

At ATB, we exist to make it possible for our clients, team members and communities. Our purpose is more than aspirational. It's a real commitment we live every day through our values (what we call the ATB ID).

About

Life at ATB is about more than work. In fact, we’re consistently recognized as one of Canada's top employers thanks to our high-care, high-performance culture, upheld by the three commitments we make to our team members:

Impact in action:
No matter where you are in the organization, you're empowered to make an impact in the lives of our clients and communities.

Thrive together:
We want you—the unique, authentic you—to feel safe and celebrated at work. We're on a continuous journey to build the most flexible and inclusive programs.

Ready for tomorrow:
We want to enable your success through interesting and challenging work, performance enablement, and learning and development.

About The Role

ATB Financial is seeking a strategic, execution-oriented leader to serve as Managing Director, Data & AI Governance
within our First Line of Defense (1B) Risk & Compliance function. Reporting directly to AVP, CXT Governance & Risk, this role will be responsible for operationalizing and managing ATB’s enterprise Data and AI risk, compliance, and control frameworks to ensure data assets and AI capabilities comply with enterprise risk appetite and regulatory standards.

Accountabilities

Operationalize and mature ATB’s enterprise Data Governance Framework and AI Governance Framework, ensuring mutual reinforcement with Information Security, Enterprise Risk Management and AI strategy.
Serve as a core 1B operational leader and SME in risk forums, managing Data & AI risk within risk appetite, and managing risk escalation pathways.
Ensure enterprise-wide adherence to OSFI Guidelines, DAMA-DMBOK, and FIFAI principles.
Oversee core DAMA-DMBOK domains including metadata harvesting, Critical Data Element (CDE) lineage tracking, data classification, data quality monitoring, and data retention/disposition.
Collaborate with technical custodians to enforce least-privilege access, dynamic masking, and obfuscation policies across golden-source environments (e.g., DEEP).
Establish and report on mandatory AI controls including but not limited to runtime controls for High-Risk Tier Agentic AI systems, enforcing Policy-as-Code (PaC), Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) checkpoints, non-human identity (NHI) scoping, and immutable Write-Once-Read-Many (WORM) trajectory logging.
Collaborate with partners to embed shift-left governance into the software development lifecycle using the AI & RAI Canvas, automated risk-tiering, and threat modeling during initial intake and ideation.
Partner with Cyber Security and Model Risk Management (MRM) to oversee continuous telemetry, trajectory logging, loop execution limits, and manual kill-switch protocols.
Partner with Data & AI teams to support their execution of enterprise AI strategy, education/literacy, and foster a culture of responsible innovation, ethical data use, and proactive risk awareness across all three lines of defense.

Skills, Experience & Requirements

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Risk Management, Business Administration, Information Management, or a related field.
10+ years of progressive leadership experience in data governance, risk management, or AI governance—preferably within the financial services or regulated sectors.
In-depth knowledge of financial regulatory guidelines, including OSFI E-21, E-23, B-10, FIFAI, NIST AI RMF, and privacy/data protection standards.
Hands-on experience with DAMA-DMBOK, enterprise data catalogs, metadata/lineage platforms (e.g., Collibra), and cloud analytics platforms (e.g., Google Cloud BigQuery/DEEP).
Demonstrated understanding of AI lifecycle management, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI architectures, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and Policy-as-Code (PaC) enforcement.
Proven ability to communicate complex risk, compliance, and governance concepts clearly to executive leadership and cross-functional teams.

Additional Job Details

This position has a hybrid work arrangement
. On average, this means 1-2 day(s) on-site per week. Please note that this is subject to change due to business priorities.

Don’t meet all the requirements on the list?

A resume only goes so far in expressing who you are and the unique perspectives you bring. If you believe your skills and experience align with the role—but you might not check all the boxes—we want to hear from you. We encourage candidates from all work backgrounds, equity-seeking communities and experience levels to apply. If you’re seeking a career where your drive, perspective and growth are celebrated, we want to hear from you.

We’re dedicated to building a workforce reflective of those within our communities, and a culture where our team members are equipped with what they need to succeed—their way. Part of creating an inclusive workplace is recognizing our role in advancing Truth and Reconciliation. We are committed to meeting and exceeding the standards set out in the Partnership Accreditation in Indigenous Relations program created by the Canadian Council for Aboriginal Business.

What happens next?

If you are shortlisted, you’ll hear from us after the posting closes. Check out our How We Hire page to learn more about our hiring process. If you need any accommodations throughout this process, please let us know at talentteam@atb.com

Stay in touch

We’re excited that you’re interested in a career with ATB. Follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram to learn more about what our team is up to.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Director, AI Business Enablement

What's the opportunity?

We're looking for a transformational leader who can serve as a strategic peer to senior business executives and drive AI-powered business transformation across an entire Line of Business or Function. As a Senior Director on the AI Business Enablement team, you will own the full AI transformation ambition for your domain — setting the vision, building the opportunity pipeline, and ensuring executive alignment from ideation through to program framing and handoff.

You will be expected to challenge, provoke, and co-develop transformation roadmaps with senior business leaders — bringing a combination of strategic rigour, AI fluency, and the credibility that comes from having built and shipped solutions, not just recommended them.

Your responsibilities will include:

Executive partnership: Holding sustained, peer-level strategic relationships with senior business leaders (SVP+); co-developing and communicating the AI-enabled transformation vision for your domain
Pipeline origination: Identifying, sizing, and prioritising a rigorous pipeline of AI transformation opportunities — including new ideas not yet on the business’ horizon — with quantified value hypotheses ready for delivery intake
AI solution concept development: Generating innovative AI solution concepts for large business problems and validating them through rapid POC cycles (weeks, not quarters)
Business model & process re-engineering: Helping leaders fundamentally rethink business processes and operating models through an AI-enabled lens
Program framing: Partnering with business leaders beyond ideation — through business case development, go-to-market strategy, and program framing — to ensure ambition translates into execution
Delivery partnership: Working closely with our world-class AI Solutions and Research teams to ensure business context and outcomes expectations are carried through into delivery — maintaining alignment between the transformation ambition and the technical execution path
Cross-enterprise pattern recognition: Surfacing reuse opportunities, multi-LOB programs, and horizontal themes that no single vertical would initiate alone
Team leadership: Leading and developing a small team of high-performing leaders aligned to sub-segments within your domain

You're our ideal candidate if you:

Have 15+ years of progressive experience in management consulting, technology, AI/ML product development, or a combination thereof
Have a track record of building AI or technology-driven solutions that created material business impact — strategy and advisory experience is valued, but must be complemented by accountability for delivery outcomes
Possess the executive gravitas and communication skills to challenge and influence senior business leaders (SVP+) as a peer
Have demonstrated experience in process re-engineering or business model redesign, ideally enabled by technology or data
Have experience partnering with technical or engineering teams to translate business requirements into solution design and ensure delivery stays aligned to intended business outcomes
Bring a consultative problem-solving approach — able to structure ambiguous problems, develop hypotheses, and drive to action quickly
Have a working knowledge of AI/ML technologies, LLMs, and data platforms — sufficient to credibly assess feasibility, shape solution concepts, and engage technical teams
Banking or financial services experience is welcome but not required; what matters is the ability to rapidly develop domain depth and business-model understanding in complex industries

What's in it for you:

Lead AI transformation at one of Canada's largest and most respected financial institutions, with direct visibility to Group Head and Operating Committee level leadership at RBC
Shape the mandate and culture of a newly formed, high-impact function within RBC's AI Group
A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock options where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact from a local-to-global scale

About the AI Group:

RBC's AI Group is the AI accelerator for RBC, with a focus on driving the shift from early-stage AI projects to scaled, client outcomes that amplify the impact of RBC's people. In addition to helping scale the biggest AI opportunities at RBC, the AI Group is responsible for advancing research into emerging use cases across generative and agentic AI, while maintaining expertise in security, responsible AI and regulatory expectations. The Business Enablement function within the AI Group partners with LOBs and Functions to set AI ambition, originate transformation opportunities, and frame programs for delivery — ensuring RBC remains at the frontier of AI-enabled value creation.
