jobs.description:
McKesson, l’une des 10 premières entreprises du classement Fortune Global 500, touche à pratiquement tous les aspects des soins de santé et s’emploie à faire une réelle différence. Nous sommes reconnus pour notre capacité à offrir un savoir, des produits et des services qui rendent les soins de qualité plus accessibles et plus abordables. Chez nous, la santé, le bonheur et le bien-être de nos gens et des personnes que nous desservons sont prioritaires—et nous tiennent à cœur.

Ce que tu fais chez McKesson a de l’importance. Nous favorisons une culture où tu peux t’épanouir et avoir un impact, et où tu es encouragé à proposer de nouvelles idées. Ensemble, nous façonnons l’avenir de la santé pour nos patients, nos communautés et nos équipes. Si tu souhaites dès aujourd’hui contribuer à la santé de demain, nous aimerions avoir de tes nouvelles.

McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

Directeur(trice) principal(e) de l’architecture de solutions/Senior Director, Solution Architecture

À propos du poste

McKesson recherche un(e) Directeur(trice) Principal(e), Architecture d’Entreprise et Expérience Numérique
pour diriger la stratégie d’architecture couvrant l’architecture de solutions, l’architecture applicative, la modernisation des solutions héritées (legacy) et la gestion de l’expérience numérique. Ce leader définira la vision de solutions technologiques modernes, évolutives, sécurisées et centrées sur le client afin de soutenir les priorités de l’entreprise et d’améliorer les résultats opérationnels.

Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez les pratiques d’architecture qui relient la stratégie d’affaires à l’exécution technologique. Vous collaborerez avec les dirigeants, les équipes produits, ingénierie, sécurité, opérations et les parties prenantes métier afin de moderniser les plateformes, simplifier les environnements hérités, orienter la stratégie d’expérience numérique et renforcer la gouvernance architecturale. Vous développerez également les talents, influencerez les décisions à l’échelle de l’entreprise et aiderez les équipes à livrer des solutions technologiques à fort impact dans un environnement complexe et réglementé.

Ce que vous ferez

Diriger la pratique d’architecture d’entreprise couvrant l’architecture de solutions, l’architecture applicative, la modernisation et la gestion de l’expérience numérique.
Définir les normes d’architecture, les feuilles de route, les modèles de gouvernance et les cadres décisionnels permettant une livraison technologique sécurisée et évolutive.
Collaborer avec les dirigeants et les responsables métier afin d’aligner la stratégie d’architecture sur les objectifs d’affaires, les besoins des clients et les priorités de l’entreprise.
Diriger les stratégies de modernisation des applications et plateformes héritées, y compris la rationalisation applicative, la migration vers le cloud, l’intégration, l’automatisation et la réduction de la dette technique.
Orienter l’architecture de l’expérience numérique afin d’améliorer l’utilisabilité, l’accessibilité, la performance, la fiabilité ainsi que les parcours clients et employés de bout en bout.
Conseiller les équipes sur les modèles d’architecture modernes, notamment les API, les microservices, les plateformes cloud natives, l’intégration de données, la gestion des identités, la sécurité et l’observabilité.
Superviser la planification du portefeuille d’architecture, la stratégie fournisseurs, les recommandations d’investissement et la création de valeur mesurable.
Développer les responsables et les équipes d’architecture grâce au mentorat, à la gestion des talents, à l’évaluation de la performance et à un leadership inclusif.

Exigences de base

13 ans ou plus d’expérience professionnelle en technologie, dont au moins 6 ans dans des fonctions de leadership en architecture, ingénierie, livraison d’applications, plateformes numériques ou transformation technologique.
Diplôme universitaire en informatique, systèmes d’information, ingénierie ou domaine connexe, ou expérience équivalente.
Expérience dans la direction d’architectures d’entreprise, de solutions ou applicatives dans des environnements technologiques de grande envergure.
Expérience de la conception et de la modernisation d’architectures de solutions d’entreprise en s’appuyant sur des plateformes intégrant l’intelligence artificielle et des technologies émergentes afin de stimuler l’innovation, l’évolutivité et la création de valeur.
Expérience dans l’élaboration de stratégies d’architecture, de feuilles de route, de normes, de modèles de gouvernance et de recommandations destinées aux dirigeants.
Expérience dans la modernisation d’applications, de plateformes ou de capacités numériques héritées.
Expérience en gestion de responsables, d’équipes d’architecture ou d’équipes technologiques multidisciplinaires.
Expérience de collaboration avec des parties prenantes métier et technologiques de haut niveau pour influencer la stratégie et l’exécution.
Expérience en planification budgétaire, gestion des fournisseurs, priorisation de portefeuille ou prise de décisions d’investissement technologique.

Compétences et expériences privilégiées

Expérience avec les plateformes cloud, les stratégies API, les microservices, l’architecture événementielle (event-driven), le DevSecOps ou l’ingénierie de plateformes.
Expérience en gestion de l’expérience numérique, plateformes d’expérience client, portails, applications mobiles/web ou solutions omnicanales.
Expérience dans les secteurs de la santé, de la distribution pharmaceutique, de la chaîne d’approvisionnement, du commerce de détail ou d’autres environnements d’entreprise réglementés.
Expérience des cadres d’architecture d’entreprise, des comités de revue d’architecture, de la modélisation des capacités ou de la gestion de portefeuille applicatif.
Expérience de direction de programmes de transformation à grande échelle impliquant plusieurs équipes, fonctions ou unités d’affaires.
Excellentes compétences en communication avec les dirigeants et capacité à simplifier des décisions technologiques complexes pour des audiences métier.
Capacité démontrée à améliorer la performance opérationnelle, réduire la dette technique et accélérer la mise sur le marché.
Style de leadership axé sur la collaboration, la vision stratégique, la conduite du changement, l’orientation client et le développement des talents.

Déplacements, présence au bureau et exigences physiques

Le modèle de travail peut être à distance, hybride ou en présentiel selon les besoins de l’entreprise et de l’équipe.
Des déplacements occasionnels peuvent être requis pour des réunions de leadership, des sessions de planification, des rencontres avec des fournisseurs ou des activités de collaboration d’équipe.
Le poste requiert une utilisation régulière de l’ordinateur ainsi qu’une participation à des réunions virtuelles et en personne.

About The Role

McKesson is seeking a Senior Director, Enterprise Architecture & Digital Experience
to lead architecture strategy across solution architecture, application architecture, legacy solution modernization, and digital experience management. This leader will set the vision for modern, scalable, secure, and customer-centered technology solutions that support enterprise priorities and improve business outcomes.

In this role, you will lead architecture practices that connect business strategy to technology execution. You will partner with senior leaders, product, engineering, security, operations, and business stakeholders to modernize platforms, simplify legacy environments, guide digital experience strategy, and strengthen architecture governance. You will also develop leaders, influence enterprise decisions, and help teams deliver high-impact technology solutions in a complex, regulated environment.

What You’ll Do

Lead the enterprise architecture practice across solution architecture, application architecture, modernization, and digital experience management.
Define architecture standards, roadmaps, governance models, and decision frameworks that enable scalable and secure technology delivery.
Partner with executive and senior business leaders to align architecture strategy with business objectives, customer needs, and enterprise priorities.
Lead legacy application and platform modernization strategies, including rationalization, cloud migration, integration, automation, and technical debt reduction.
Guide digital experience architecture to improve usability, accessibility, performance, reliability, and end-to-end customer and employee journeys.
Advise teams on modern architecture patterns, including APIs, microservices, cloud-native platforms, data integration, identity, security, and observability.
Oversee architecture portfolio planning, vendor strategy, investment recommendations, and measurable value delivery.
Build and develop architecture leaders and teams through coaching, talent planning, performance management, and inclusive leadership practices.

Basic Requirements

13+ years of professional technology experience, including 6+ years of leadership experience in architecture, engineering, application delivery, digital platforms, or technology transformation.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
Experience leading enterprise, solution, or application architecture across large-scale technology environments.
Lead the design and modernization of enterprise solution architectures, leveraging AI-enabled platforms and emerging technologies to drive innovation, scalability, and business value.
Experience developing architecture strategy, roadmaps, standards, governance, and executive-level recommendations.
Experience leading modernization of legacy applications, platforms, or digital capabilities.
Experience managing leaders, architecture teams, or cross-functional technology teams.
Experience partnering with senior business and technology stakeholders to influence strategy and delivery.
Experience with budget planning, vendor management, portfolio prioritization, or technology investment decisions.

Preferred Skills/Experience

Experience with cloud platforms, API strategy, microservices, event-driven architecture, DevSecOps, or platform engineering.
Experience with digital experience management, customer experience platforms, portals, mobile/web applications, or omnichannel solutions.
Experience in healthcare, pharmaceutical distribution, supply chain, retail, or other regulated enterprise environments.
Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks, architecture review boards, capability modeling, or application portfolio management.
Experience leading large-scale transformation programs across multiple teams, functions, or business units.
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technology decisions for business audiences.
Demonstrated ability to improve operational performance, reduce technical debt, and increase speed-to-market.
Leadership approach aligned to collaboration, strategic insight, change leadership, customer focus, and talent development.

Description Of Travel Or In-Office And Physical Requirements

Work model may be remote, hybrid, or office-based depending on business and team needs.
Occasional travel may be required for leadership meetings, planning sessions, vendor engagements, or team collaboration.

Job Description:

Location
: hybrid, work from home

The Director, Corporate Underwriting Analytics and Digital Risk is a high performer in the underwriting risk community who thrives on the challenge of applying innovative problem-solving skills and solutions that align with Sun Life's risk tolerance. As a member of the Corporate Risk team, this person will foster a forward thinking, collaborative, and results oriented mindset within the team and key stakeholders throughout the Sun Life Enterprise. This position is a global risk role and will interact and liaise with risk management teams across the world.

What will you do?

Direct and complete activities related to the redesigning of existing programs to manage mortality and morbidity risk as they pertain to the underwriting risk management framework for the enterprise.
Develop performance management tools and processes to ensure compliance with the Enterprise Underwriting Operating Guideline.
Assess mortality and morbidity experience and report to the Corporate Chief Underwriter with thorough investigation of findings, assessment of any material risk implications, and recommendation for corrective actions.
Serve as an expert resource for referral of complex medically underwriting cases and financial underwriting risks. Make final decisions on complex underwriting risks within stated approval authority.
As Second Line of Defense, review and challenge the Business Unit's policies and practices to ensure compliance to the Underwriting Enterprise Operating Guideline.
Provide updates to the Director, Risk Controls and Compliance regarding any non-compliances to the UWEOG.
Develop strong relationships and partnerships with the Global Underwriting teams, product and pricing teams, Insurance Risk team and internal and external reinsurance partners.
Under the direction of the VP, Chief Underwriter, assist in driving changes to methodologies and practices which may present unfavorable mortality/morbidity experience through research, analysis of medical and non-medical risk factors, and presentation of key findings to underwriting leadership.

What do you need to succeed?

Minimum 10 years experience as an individual Life Underwriter, underwriting of multiple lines of business or products for multiple distribution channels.
Previous life approval authority of $10,000,000 and critical illness approval authority of $1,000,000.
Knowledge of and practical application of various risk assessment tools such as AI, risk propensity models, automated underwriting workflows, and various point of sales tools such as direct to consumer, and how they impact mortality/morbidity results as well as a strong understanding of non-medical issues such as fraud.
Knowledge of product development practices and concepts and assessment of risk to the organization, adherence to UWEOG and corporate risk appetite.
Ability to learn on the fly and with limited knowledge and in a dynamic work environment, as well as take a project from ideation to implementation.
Ability to apply underwriting, statistical analysis, mathematical, and actuarial knowledge to ensure delivery of team deliverables and implement projects/assignments to completion.
Knowledge of industry best practices and standards.
In-depth knowledge of underwriting risk assessment tools and standards as they relate to risk management programs.
Well-developed interpersonal as well as excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work independently and make complex decisions in a risk setting.
As this position is posted in several locations, we specify that bilingualism (French, English, both oral and written) is required for Quebec only for the frequent interactions with English and French-speaking colleagues or internal partners across Canada or worldwide.

Reasons why should you join us under the sun

A collaborative and interactive team environment.
Opportunities to own your career development with programs to continuously learn, build skills, grow through coaching and more.
As a hybrid organization, you and your leader use business and Client needs to choose where you work, at home or in the office.

Job Description:

Location
: hybrid, work from home

The Director, Corporate Underwriting Analytics and Digital Risk is a high performer in the underwriting risk community who thrives on the challenge of applying innovative problem-solving skills and solutions that align with Sun Life's risk tolerance. As a member of the Corporate Risk team, this person will foster a forward thinking, collaborative, and results oriented mindset within the team and key stakeholders throughout the Sun Life Enterprise. This position is a global risk role and will interact and liaise with risk management teams across the world.

What will you do?

Direct and complete activities related to the redesigning of existing programs to manage mortality and morbidity risk as they pertain to the underwriting risk management framework for the enterprise.
Develop performance management tools and processes to ensure compliance with the Enterprise Underwriting Operating Guideline.
Assess mortality and morbidity experience and report to the Corporate Chief Underwriter with thorough investigation of findings, assessment of any material risk implications, and recommendation for corrective actions.
Serve as an expert resource for referral of complex medically underwriting cases and financial underwriting risks. Make final decisions on complex underwriting risks within stated approval authority.
As Second Line of Defense, review and challenge the Business Unit's policies and practices to ensure compliance to the Underwriting Enterprise Operating Guideline.
Provide updates to the Director, Risk Controls and Compliance regarding any non-compliances to the UWEOG.
Develop strong relationships and partnerships with the Global Underwriting teams, product and pricing teams, Insurance Risk team and internal and external reinsurance partners.
Under the direction of the VP, Chief Underwriter, assist in driving changes to methodologies and practices which may present unfavorable mortality/morbidity experience through research, analysis of medical and non-medical risk factors, and presentation of key findings to underwriting leadership.

What do you need to succeed?

Minimum 10 years experience as an individual Life Underwriter, underwriting of multiple lines of business or products for multiple distribution channels.
Previous life approval authority of $10,000,000 and critical illness approval authority of $1,000,000.
Knowledge of and practical application of various risk assessment tools such as AI, risk propensity models, automated underwriting workflows, and various point of sales tools such as direct to consumer, and how they impact mortality/morbidity results as well as a strong understanding of non-medical issues such as fraud.
Knowledge of product development practices and concepts and assessment of risk to the organization, adherence to UWEOG and corporate risk appetite.
Ability to learn on the fly and with limited knowledge and in a dynamic work environment, as well as take a project from ideation to implementation.
Ability to apply underwriting, statistical analysis, mathematical, and actuarial knowledge to ensure delivery of team deliverables and implement projects/assignments to completion.
Knowledge of industry best practices and standards.
In-depth knowledge of underwriting risk assessment tools and standards as they relate to risk management programs.
Well-developed interpersonal as well as excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work independently and make complex decisions in a risk setting.
As this position is posted in several locations, we specify that bilingualism (French, English, both oral and written) is required for Quebec only for the frequent interactions with English and French-speaking colleagues or internal partners across Canada or worldwide.

jobs.description:
Join one of Canada’s fastest-growing companies and be part of something extraordinary – welcome to goeasy
! At goeasy, our people and culture are at the heart of everything we do, and we’re proud to be recognized for it. We’ve earned prestigious accolades such as Waterstone Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures
and Canada’s Top Growing Companies
. We’re also honoured to be named a Greater Toronto Top Employer
and recognized by Great Place to Work®
as having the Best Workplaces for Women
& Most Trusted Executive Teams
, and included on TIME Magazine’s 2025 list of Canada’s Best Companies
. These honours reflect our commitment to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where talent thrives and innovation drives us forward.

As one of Canada’s leading alternative consumer lenders, we’re passionate about helping everyday Canadians create a brighter future. Our vision is to provide a path to a better tomorrow, today. We offer a full range of products, including non-prime leasing, unsecured and secured loans, and point-of-sale financing through easyhome
, easyfinancial
, and LendCare
.
If you're seeking an exciting, high-growth environment where your contributions truly matter, we want to hear from you! Join us, and together, let's create a future of financial empowerment.

About The Role

At goeasy, we believe everyone deserves access to fair and responsible credit. Every day, we help Canadians who are building or rebuilding their financial future access the products and support they need to move forward with confidence. We're looking for a Director, Collections Strategy & Performance
who understands that Collections is about more than recoveries. It's about finding the right balance between customer outcomes, responsible lending, risk management, and business performance. We are looking for a strategic and analytical problem solver who can use data, insights, and sound business judgment to identify opportunities and improve how we operate.

This is not a traditional Collections Director role.

You'll have the opportunity to influence strategy, lead transformation, and help shape the future of one of goeasy's most important functions. With significant autonomy and visibility, you'll partner across Operations, Analytics, Technology, Risk, and Compliance to build better experiences for customers while driving strong business results.

What You'll Do

Help define and execute the strategy for a critical part of goeasy's business.
Identify opportunities to improve customer outcomes, portfolio performance, and operational effectiveness.
Lead initiatives across Collections, Recoveries, Third-Party Partners, Offshore Operations, Technology, and Analytics.
Use data and insights to inform decisions and influence business strategy.
Diagnose complex and ambiguous business problems, identify underlying performance drivers, and develop practical solutions.
Translate analysis and insights into clear recommendations, priorities, and execution plans.
Develop performance frameworks, reporting, and operating rhythms that improve visibility, decision-making, and accountability.
Strengthen risk management, governance, and regulatory compliance practices.
Build and improve processes that create better experiences for customers and employees.
Develop high-performing teams and future leaders.
Bring new ideas, challenge assumptions, and help drive the next phase of goeasy's evolution.

What We're Looking For

8-15 years of leadership experience in Collections, Operations, Strategy, Risk Management, Financial Services, Consulting, Analytics or a related field.
Strong analytical capabilities and the ability to turn complex information into clear business insights and recommendations.
Demonstrated experience solving ambiguous business problems and identifying the underlying drivers of performance.
Strong business judgment, curiosity, and a practical, outcomes-oriented approach.
Experience leading large-scale business improvements and transformational change.
Strong business acumen, analytical capabilities, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to connect strategy with execution and lead initiatives from analysis through implementation.
Ability to balance customer needs, business objectives, and regulatory requirements.
Experience in Collections, call centre operations, third-party vendors, agencies, or offshore partners is considered an asset but is not required.

We offer a Flexible Work Program that provides you the ability to work three days onsite per week
, from our Mississauga office.

Internal Applicants:
please apply through the link and provide written endorsement from your current manager.

Why should you work for goeasy?

Financial Benefits

In keeping with our mission to create better tomorrows for our employees, each year goeasy commits to continuously enhancing its total rewards. Here are some of the perks we offer:
Performance-based annual bonus and long-term equity incentives designed to support leadership impact and long-term wealth creation.
As a TSX-listed company (GSY), goeasy offers long-term equity incentives, giving team members the opportunity to contribute to and benefit from our continued success.
Employee discounts on furniture, electronics, and appliances.
MAT & PAT leave top-up.

Leadership & Career Growth

Access to high-impact, high-visibility roles with direct influence on business outcomes.
Participation in goeasy’s executive leadership development programs.
Lead your own development journey with personalized growth plans, supported by coaching and mentorship to help you reach your leadership goals.
Fuel your personal and professional growth with our Tuition Assistance Program.

Health and Lifestyle

Immediate enrollment in comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits.
Access 24/7 healthcare with Virtual Doctor Appointments.
Exclusive access to our free on-site goeasy gym and fitness studio at head office.
Explore a wide range of wellness options through our new Wellhub benefit – from fitness memberships to mental health resources.
Enjoy a state-of-the-art office space with perks like a games room, healthy snack program, free gated parking.
Give back with company-paid volunteer days and Company Matched Charitable Donations.

Diversity, Inclusion, And Equal Opportunity Employment

At goeasy, we believe that we can only be the best when people are able to bring their best selves to work every day. goeasy is committed to an inclusive, equitable and accessible workplace. By learning from each other’s differences, we gain strength through our people and our perspectives. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing accommodations (including accessible meeting rooms, captioning for virtual interviews, etc.) to help us remove barriers so that you can participate throughout the interview process. Please let the talent acquisition team know if you require an accommodation during any aspect of the recruitment process and we will work with you to address your needs.

Additional Information

All candidates considered for hire must successfully pass a criminal background check, credit check, and validation of their work experience to qualify for hire. We thank all interested applicants; however, we will only be contacting those for interview who possess the skills and qualifications outlined above.

jobs.title: Director, Pricing Strategy and Operations
jobs.description:
At Varicent, We’re Not Just Transforming The Sales Performance Management (SPM) Market—we’re Redefining How Organizations Achieve Revenue Success. Our Cutting-edge SaaS Solutions Empower Revenue Leaders Globally To Design Smarter Go-to-market Strategies, Maximize Seller Performance, And Unlock Untapped Potential. Varicent Stands At The Forefront Of Innovation, Celebrated As a Market Leader In The 2025 Forrester Wave Report For SPM, 2023 Ventana Research Revenue Performance Management (RPM) Value Index, Gartner Peer Insights, 2024 Gartner SPM Market Guide, And G2. Our Solutions Are Trusted By a Diverse Range Of Global Industry Leaders Like T-Mobile, ServiceNow, Wawanesa Bank, Shaw Industries, Moody's, Stryker And Hundreds More. Here’s Why You’ll Thrive At Varicent

Innovate with Purpose: Build impactful solutions for customers worldwide.
Join Excellence: Work in a diverse, collaborative, and innovative team.
Shape the Future: Lead in redefining revenue optimization.
Grow Together: Unlock your potential in a supportive environment.

Join us at Varicent—where your talent and ambition meet limitless opportunities for success!

Summary Of The Role And Team

As Director of Deal Desk & Pricing, you will lead and scale Varicent's Deal Desk function, serving as the central authority for deal governance, pricing operations, quote-to-booking processes, and commercial execution. You'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Renewals, Finance, Legal, Product, and Revenue Operations to drive pricing accuracy, data integrity, operational efficiency, and compliance throughout the customer lifecycle. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution — you'll establish the processes, governance frameworks, systems alignment, and team structure that enable scalable growth. This is a people leadership role: you'll manage and grow Deal Desk professionals while improving deal velocity, profitability, forecasting accuracy, and operational excellence.

What You Will Be Doing

Lead and develop the Deal Desk team, including coaching, performance management, capacity planning, and workload prioritization.
Establish and run Deal Desk operating processes: deal intake, approvals, escalations, service-level expectations, and stakeholder communications.
Own quote-to-booking governance for new business, renewals, expansions, and cross-sell opportunities, ensuring pricing accuracy and policy compliance.
Work with Sales and Customer Success on deal structuring, pricing decisions, exception management, and commercial approvals.
Maintain data integrity and system alignment across Salesforce, CPQ platforms, pricing tools, and related commercial systems.
Partner with Finance on forecasting activities, revenue recognition requirements, commercial risk assessments, and audit readiness.
Build and maintain governance frameworks, policies, documentation, and enablement resources that drive consistent business practices.
Lead process improvement and change management initiatives to reduce deal cycle times and improve scalability and reporting quality.

What You Bring

Demonstrated expertise in Deal Desk, Pricing, Revenue Operations, Commercial Operations, FP&A, Commercial Finance, or related business functions (typically gained over 10–12+ years)
Experience leading teams, programs, or cross-functional operational functions (typically 5+ years)
Experience with complex B2B sales motions, including new business, renewals, expansions, and cross-sell transactions
Expertise in Deal Desk operations, pricing governance, quote-to-booking workflows, commercial approvals, and process design
Experience working with Salesforce, DealHub CPQ, or comparable CPQ/CRM platforms
Solid grasp of how pricing structures, commercial terms, ACV, and contract structures impact forecasting and revenue recognition
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of using operational data to improve business processes and decisions
Ability to influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Legal, Customer Success, Product, and Revenue Operations

Success Outcomes

First 90 Days

Build a working understanding of Varicent's pricing structure, commercial processes, systems landscape, and quote-to-booking workflows.
Establish strong relationships with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Product, and Revenue Operations stakeholders.
Assess current Deal Desk processes, governance controls, approval workflows, and reporting capabilities.
Identify opportunities to improve deal execution efficiency, data quality, and process consistency.

Within 6 Months

Roll out clear governance frameworks, approval structures, and operational standards across the Deal Desk function.
Raise quote quality, pricing accuracy, and first-pass approval rates while cutting rework and processing delays.
Set up consistent forecasting workflows with Finance using Deal Desk insights and commercial data.
Strengthen data integrity and alignment across Salesforce, CPQ platforms, pricing tools, and related systems.
Develop scalable team operating rhythms and performance metrics aligned to business objectives.

Within 12 Months

Position Deal Desk as a go-to strategic partner across Go-To-Market, Finance, and Executive teams.
Show measurable gains in deal cycle times, pricing governance, compliance, and forecasting accuracy.
Deliver scalable quote-to-booking processes that support growth while maintaining strong controls and audit readiness.
Build a high-performing Deal Desk organization with clear accountability and operational excellence.
Create a sustainable operating model that supports revenue growth, profitability objectives, and commercial scalability.

This posting is for a existing
vacancy.

This hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement — not replace — human decision-making.

Overview Of Benefits

Health & Wellness — Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage tailored to your local needs
Time Off — PTO and public holidays to rest, recharge, and do what matters most
Volunteer Days — Dedicated time to give back and support the communities that matter to you
Ignite Days — Dedicated learning days to support continuous growth, skill development, and professional learning
Financial — Compensation that reflects your market and your value
Retirement — Retirement plans designed to help you build long-term financial security
Tuition Assistance — Invest in your growth with support for continuing education and professional development
Flexibility — Work where you thrive, with remote and hybrid options available across most regions

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. jobs.title: Senior Vice President, Enterprise Risk Management
jobs.description:
Experience Aviva

Together, we are Aviva.

Our values of Care, Commitment, Community, and Confidence guide how we show up for each other and our customers. At Aviva Canada, we put people first through a culture built on inclusion, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

The Opportunity

The SVP, Enterprise Risk Management is a key member of the Aviva Canada Senior Risk Leadership Team, responsible for providing enterprise-wide leadership across risk business partnering, quantitative risk, insurance and financial risk, capital, model risk, and risk analytics. The role supports the effective performance of Aviva Canada by overseeing the implementation of the Risk Management Framework, providing independent oversight and challenge to the first line, and ensuring the organization operates within its Board-approved risk appetite.

Working closely with the Chief Risk Officer, Executive Committee, and business leaders, the SVP delivers commercially focused risk insight and independent challenge on strategic and business decisions. The role acts as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, ensuring robust governance, effective risk management, and a strong risk culture that support Aviva Canada's strategic objectives, regulatory obligations, and long-term resilience.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will be accountable for the following key areas:

Enterprise Risk Leadership and Strategy

Partner with the ACAN CRO to shape and execute Aviva Canada's risk strategy and ensure the effective operation of the Risk Management Framework.
Provide independent, commercially focused risk insight and challenge to support strategic decision-making, growth objectives, and long-term value creation.
Ensure the organization operates within Board-approved risk appetite and maintains effective risk governance, oversight, and risk culture.
Support Executive Committee, Board Risk Committee, and ACAN Board reporting on key risk exposures, emerging risks, and risk management effectiveness.

Risk Oversight and Independent Challenge

Lead independent oversight of Aviva Canada's aggregate risk profile, including insurance, financial, capital, model, technology, data, change, and operational risks.
Provide effective review and challenge of business plans, capital deployment decisions, reinsurance strategies, material transactions, product development, pricing, and other significant business initiatives.
Monitor emerging risks and material changes in risk exposure, ensuring appropriate mitigation strategies are identified and executed.
Escalate significant risk issues and risk appetite breaches, providing clear recommendations for remediation and management action.

Quantitative, Capital and Model Risk Management

Provide enterprise leadership for insurance risk, financial risk, capital risk, risk modelling and risk analytics.
Accountable for overseeing Internal Model Independent Validation (IMIV) and material model governance across Aviva Canada.
Oversee independent validation activities and provide challenge on capital adequacy, economic capital, liquidity, financial resilience, and risk-return optimization.
Drive the evolution of quantitative risk capabilities and risk analytics to enhance business decision making and risk insights.

Business Partnering and Stakeholder Management

Lead the Risk Business Partnering team, ensuring Risk is a trusted advisor and constructive challenger to business leaders across Aviva Canada.

jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

Location
: hybrid, work from home

The Director, Corporate Underwriting Analytics and Digital Risk is a high performer in the underwriting risk community who thrives on the challenge of applying innovative problem-solving skills and solutions that align with Sun Life's risk tolerance. As a member of the Corporate Risk team, this person will foster a forward thinking, collaborative, and results oriented mindset within the team and key stakeholders throughout the Sun Life Enterprise. This position is a global risk role and will interact and liaise with risk management teams across the world.

What will you do?

Direct and complete activities related to the redesigning of existing programs to manage mortality and morbidity risk as they pertain to the underwriting risk management framework for the enterprise.
Develop performance management tools and processes to ensure compliance with the Enterprise Underwriting Operating Guideline.
Assess mortality and morbidity experience and report to the Corporate Chief Underwriter with thorough investigation of findings, assessment of any material risk implications, and recommendation for corrective actions.
Serve as an expert resource for referral of complex medically underwriting cases and financial underwriting risks. Make final decisions on complex underwriting risks within stated approval authority.
As Second Line of Defense, review and challenge the Business Unit's policies and practices to ensure compliance to the Underwriting Enterprise Operating Guideline.
Provide updates to the Director, Risk Controls and Compliance regarding any non-compliances to the UWEOG.
Develop strong relationships and partnerships with the Global Underwriting teams, product and pricing teams, Insurance Risk team and internal and external reinsurance partners.
Under the direction of the VP, Chief Underwriter, assist in driving changes to methodologies and practices which may present unfavorable mortality/morbidity experience through research, analysis of medical and non-medical risk factors, and presentation of key findings to underwriting leadership.

What do you need to succeed?

Minimum 10 years experience as an individual Life Underwriter, underwriting of multiple lines of business or products for multiple distribution channels.
Previous life approval authority of $10,000,000 and critical illness approval authority of $1,000,000.
Knowledge of and practical application of various risk assessment tools such as AI, risk propensity models, automated underwriting workflows, and various point of sales tools such as direct to consumer, and how they impact mortality/morbidity results as well as a strong understanding of non-medical issues such as fraud.
Knowledge of product development practices and concepts and assessment of risk to the organization, adherence to UWEOG and corporate risk appetite.
Ability to learn on the fly and with limited knowledge and in a dynamic work environment, as well as take a project from ideation to implementation.
Ability to apply underwriting, statistical analysis, mathematical, and actuarial knowledge to ensure delivery of team deliverables and implement projects/assignments to completion.
Knowledge of industry best practices and standards.
In-depth knowledge of underwriting risk assessment tools and standards as they relate to risk management programs.
Well-developed interpersonal as well as excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work independently and make complex decisions in a risk setting.
As this position is posted in several locations, we specify that bilingualism (French, English, both oral and written) is required for Quebec only for the frequent interactions with English and French-speaking colleagues or internal partners across Canada or worldwide.

Reasons why should you join us under the sun

A collaborative and interactive team environment.
Opportunities to own your career development with programs to continuously learn, build skills, grow through coaching and more.
As a hybrid organization, you and your leader use business and Client needs to choose where you work, at home or in the office.
Our unique Sabbatical Program gives you the opportunity to take up to 6 weeks off, every five years.
We are proud to be on the 2026 Best Workplaces in Canada list by Great Place to Work.

In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.description:

Welcome to TELUS Digital, where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across eight core service areas: Digital Product Consulting, Digital Marketing Services, Data & AI, Strategy Consulting, Enterprise Technology, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Engineering, and QA & Test Engineering.

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are, all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

Location

This role will be based out of one of our major US or Canada
office locations: Charlottesville, VA, Durham, NC, Columbus, OH, Boston, MA, Toronto, ON, or Vancouver, BC.

This business unit specializes in data-driven solutions and strategic AI implementation. We help our clients unlock the full potential of their data and transform their business through innovative, AI-powered strategies.

Our Managing Director, Data, AI & Cloud, will lead our Data & AI advisory, AI solutions, Data platforms, and cloud transformation capabilities. If you are passionate about data, AI, and strategic consulting, we invite you to apply and join our high-performing team.

Drive growth by identifying emerging trends, market opportunities, and industry best practices
Lead the planning, development, and execution of the Data, AI & Cloud strategic roadmap

Assume overall accountability for the financial performance of the Data, AI & Cloud consulting practice
Partner with Practice Leaders and Business Development to continue to grow managed accounts
In partnership with Business Development, develop and implement effective revenue generation strategies to meet or exceed annual revenue targets
Monitor financial performance, identify areas for improvement, and implement corrective actions as necessary

Team Leadership And Management

Foster a culture of excellence, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning within the Data, AI & Cloud teams globally and more broadly through the Practice Advisor team

Client Engagement And Delivery

Partner with clients to identify their business challenges and design tailored Data, AI & Cloud solutions
Oversee the delivery of high-quality data-driven insights, models, and strategic recommendations
Provide thought leadership and build trusted advisor relationships with key client stakeholders

Competencies

Experience

10+ years of relevant leadership and team management experience within a top-tier management consultancy (Partner-level) or global and publicly traded enterprise (VP, SVP, or C-level) with a focus on AI, Data Engineering, Data Science, or Related Fields
Leads a line of business for a mid-size to large consultancy (i.e., office, industry, etc.)
Leadership experience in technology consulting, project management, and executive partnerships
Clear and tested experience in leading cross-functional teams and managing P&L responsibilities

Industry Knowledge

In-depth knowledge of Data Engineering, Data Science, and AI technologies and tools
Familiarity with emerging trends, best practices, and advancements in Data, AI & Cloud applications
Track record of being a dynamic decision-maker and having adaptability in a quickly changing environment
Deep knowledge of customer experience strategies and digital transformation

Leadership Competencies

Exceptional leadership and people management skills, inspiring and motivating cross-functional teams
Excellent strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities, with strong business acumen
Proven ability to develop and maintain effective relationships with clients and key stakeholders

Communication And Collaboration

Outstanding communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present complex ideas effectively to C-level and Executive audiences
Strong collaborator with the ability to work seamlessly across diverse teams and cultures
Proficiency in English is required; additional fluency in Spanish or Portuguese is a plus

jobs.description:
Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We Are Proud Of

The work we do and the innovation we drive
Our values of share, care and dare
A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

Please note, we are only accepting applicants from the provinces of Ontario and Québec for this role.
For Québec-based candidates, fluency in English is necessary because the position entails collaboration with teams based in the rest of Americas and occasionally in Europe.

We're looking for a Senior Vice President, Strategy
to lead and evolve our strategy practice across the Americas. This executive leader will serve as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, shape strategic pursuits, define market-leading offerings, elevate Valtech's industry presence, and build an AI-native strategy function that drives measurable business impact.

You Will Thrive In This Role If You Are

A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing
Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data
Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)

Role Responsibilities

Executive Client Advisory

Serve as a trusted advisor to executive client leaders, including CMOs, CIOs, and other senior stakeholders.
Help clients navigate the intersection of brand strategy, customer experience, data, technology, and AI.
Develop and defend strategic points of view on personalization, data activation, AI, and growth.
Connect brand differentiation with data-driven customer engagement strategies.
Advise organizations on how AI is transforming content production, marketing operations, and the broader customer experience ecosystem.
Build trusted relationships that open, expand, and strengthen client partnerships.

Strategic Pursuits & Business Development

Shape opportunities before formal pursuit phases begin by helping clients define business challenges and strategic priorities.
Partner with account teams to identify, qualify, and develop high-value opportunities.
Bring a compelling perspective across brand, creative, data, AI, and technology solutions.
Guide pursuit strategy and support proposal and RFP development activities.
Evaluate pursuit investment decisions and prioritize opportunities with the highest strategic value and growth potential.

Pursuit Leadership

Lead strategic pursuit narratives from opportunity identification through final client presentations.
Develop compelling solution stories and differentiated value propositions.
Collaborate with commercial and pricing teams to align strategic positioning with commercial models.
Coach and support presenting teams during client decision-making processes.
Capture lessons learned from both successful and unsuccessful pursuits and translate insights into future improvements.

Offering Development

Transform market and client insights into scalable, repeatable service offerings.
Define how strategy, brand, data activation, personalization, and AI offerings are packaged, positioned, and sold.
Continuously evolve offerings in response to changes in technology, AI capabilities, and market demand.
Partner across practices to ensure integrated solutions and consistent client experiences.

Thought Leadership & Market Presence

Represent Valtech at industry conferences, executive forums, analyst briefings, and client events.
Develop original intellectual property, research, and thought leadership content.
Build awareness of Valtech's AI-native positioning and experience innovation capabilities.
Strengthen relationships with analysts, strategic partners, and key industry influencers.

Practice Leadership

Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of strategists across the Americas.
Establish scalable operating models, tools, and ways of working for the strategy practice.
Partner closely with Creative, Data & AI, and Technology leaders to deliver integrated client outcomes.
Define and implement AI-native approaches to research, synthesis, strategic development, pursuit support, and practice operations.
Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.

Must Have Qualifications

To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:

Significant experience in strategy consulting, digital consulting, business transformation, or a related advisory discipline.
Proven success advising CMOs, marketing leaders, and executive stakeholders on business growth and transformation initiatives.
Demonstrated ability to engage credibly with CIOs and technology leaders on the relationship between technology investments and business outcomes.
Deep understanding of customer experience, brand strategy, data activation, personalization, and AI-driven transformation.
Experience leading complex, multidisciplinary pursuits from qualification through deal closure.
Strong track record of building and scaling high-performing strategy or advisory teams.
Experience defining operating models, methodologies, and business practices for growing consulting organizations.
Proven ability to establish and scale AI-enabled or AI-native approaches within strategy and consulting environments.
Excellent executive communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.
Ability to navigate complex, matrixed organizations and influence stakeholders across multiple functions

Nice To Have Qualifications

External market presence through speaking engagements, published thought leadership, analyst engagement, or industry participation.
Experience working across brand, marketing, data, and technology transformation initiatives.
Established relationships with strategic alliance or technology partners.
Experience supporting global clients and large-scale transformation programs.

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

The Benefits

This is a Full time
position based in Canada
. The offered salary range is $ 170,000 CAD - $220, 000 CAD
annually, depending on experience and location.

Valtech offers a comprehensive benefits package effective after three months of continuous service:

A comprehensive insurance plan, where you can choose the module that best suits your needs—Gold, Silver, or Bronze. The employer may contribute up to 80% of your coverage depending on the selected module. This plan includes short- and long-term disability coverage.
Dialogue via Sun Life provides virtual healthcare services, allowing you to consult with a healthcare professional for emergencies, prescription renewals, and more. You also have access to the Employee and Family Assistance Program, as well as a complete mental health support program.
A $500 Personal Spending Account, which can be used for healthcare reimbursements, gym memberships, public transit passes, office supplies, or contributions to your RRSP through Valtech.
A retirement plan where Valtech will match 100% of your RRSP contributions through a Deferred Profit Sharing Plan (DPSP), up to a maximum of 4%. You can start contributing to your RRSP immediately, and to the DPSP after 3 months. The vesting of the DPSP will be after a 24 months of service.
Access to a flexible vacation under Valtech's policy to support your work-life balance, with 5 days available during your probation period and a prorated amount calculated for the remainder of the year.
Personal Technology Reimbursement – $30/month for every employee-offered on day 1.
We close during the winter holidays and offer flexible scheduling throughout the year, so you can enjoy those sunny Friday afternoons—provided your weekly hours are completed.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Enterprise Operations & Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together.

About the Team:

Citi is looking for a Lead AI/ML Data Scientist
to join the Olympus Data Reconciliation and Engineering team, where you will shape the next generation of AI and machine learning capabilities powering enterprise-scale reconciliation across global processing hubs.

In this role, you will drive the full lifecycle of ML model development — from ideation and architecture through to deployment and adoption — delivering measurable impact across Capital Markets operations, risk, and finance. Your work will sit at the intersection of advanced data science and real-world financial systems, influencing outcomes at a global scale.

Responsibilities:

Design, build, and deploy AI and machine learning models — including Agentic AI and Generative AI solutions — to solve complex reconciliation and data engineering challenges at enterprise scale.
Lead the end-to-end ML model development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and data preprocessing through to ensemble modeling, validation, and production integration.
Analyze large volumes of structured and unstructured financial data to uncover trends, patterns, and opportunities for optimization across banking platforms.
Define and deliver ML model roadmaps in collaboration with technical and business teams, ensuring alignment with project timelines, budgets, and Citi's architecture standards.
Translate complex data findings into clear visualizations and strategic recommendations that inform decisions made by senior business and technology leaders.
Partner with engineering, operations, and cross-functional teams to ensure seamless model integration, long-term scalability, and reliable performance in production environments.

6+ years hands-on experience in AI/ML development and big data engineering within Financial Services, Insurance, or Telecom environments
Expert-level proficiency in Python (scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Pandas, NumPy), R (caret, tidyverse, mlr3), and SQL (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL)
Deep technical knowledge implementing supervised and unsupervised ML algorithms: linear/logistic regression, neural networks (CNN, RNN, LSTM, Transformers), k-means clustering, DBSCAN, decision trees (CART, C4.5), and ensemble methods (Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost)
Proven experience building and deploying Agentic AI and LLM-based solutions using:
LangGraph for complex agent orchestration and state management
LangChain for chain-of-thought reasoning and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
Agent Development Kit (ADK) for enterprise-grade autonomous agent development

Hands-on experience with advanced statistical modeling: Generalized Linear Models (GLM), Random Forest, Gradient Boosting (AdaBoost, XGBoost), and Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques including text mining, topic modeling (LDA), and sentiment analysis
Experience with model versioning and experiment tracking tools (Mlflow, Weights & Biases, DVC)
Proficiency with Git/GitHub/Bitbucket for version control and collaborative development
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for ML model deployment (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions)
Familiarity with data visualization libraries (Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly) and BI tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience with real-time streaming data frameworks (Kafka, Kinesis)
Passion for staying current with emerging AI/ML frameworks, research papers, and open-source contributions

We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

Our Applied Artificial Intelligence (AI) team within Operations helps turn high-value opportunities into practical solutions that improve how work gets done across the business. You'll lead and develop a team of data scientists while creating the structure, operating rhythm, and accountability needed to deliver consistently in a complex enterprise environment. Working closely with Operations leaders and cross-functional partners, you'll translate business problems into clear, well-scoped initiatives with measurable outcomes. jobs.title: Director, Artificial Intelligence, Finance
jobs.description:
Overview

AtkinsRéalis is looking for a Director, Artificial Intelligence, Finance to turn the potential of AI into measurable improvements in how Finance works and how the business makes decisions.

This is a hands-on leadership role. The Director will define a practical AI strategy, identify the opportunities worth pursuing and lead a disciplined portfolio from business case through adoption and verified results. They will also personally design, build, test and help deploy practical Finance agents and AI-enabled workflows within approved enterprise environments.

Success means tangible outcomes: capacity released for higher-value work, faster and better-informed decisions, stronger controls, improved cash performance and protection of project margins. The role is not about deploying technology for its own sake or accumulating pilots that never change how Finance operates.

Leading a small team with a global mandate, the Director will bring together Finance leaders and process owners with the Financial Systems Centre of Excellence (CoE), IT, Global Digital, the Chief Digital Officer's'organization, and data, cybersecurity, privacy and risk specialists. They will develop Finance-specific strategy and governance within enterprise standards, not create competing platforms or policies.

You are a business-led AI and transformation leader who combines strategic ambition, financial discipline and genuine hands-on ability. You can inspire executives, challenge a weak business case and align Finance, Digital, IT and control teams. You are as comfortable discussing strategy as you are building an agent to test an idea with users.

Your role

Set The Strategy And Build Alignment

Define and communicate a value-first AI strategy and roadmap for Global Finance, aligned with Finance priorities, enterprise AI strategy, technology standards and the Financial Systems roadmap.
Determine where AI can materially improve outcomes, where conventional automation or process redesign is preferable, and where an opportunity should not proceed.
Build a shared agenda across FP&A, Controllership, Project Finance and other Finance teams; engage regional and business leaders to identify needs that can scale.
Advise Finance leadership on investment choices, dependencies and risks; secure sponsorship and rally teams that do not report to the Director.

Own a Disciplined Portfolio Of Use Cases

Establish transparent intake and prioritization connected to enterprise channels and governance; assess business value, process and data readiness, feasibility, adoption, total cost and risk.
Maintain a sequenced portfolio with named sponsors, accountable process owners, delivery partners, milestones and clear decisions to proceed, change direction or stop.
Prioritize a few opportunities with a credible path to impact over a large collection of pilots. Candidate areas include reporting commentary, Finance knowledge access, exception handling, forecasting support, collections and project-margin early warning; each requires its own assessment and business case.

Make The Business Case And Prove The Return

Require proportionate business cases before material investment, with baselines, expected benefits, implementation and ongoing costs, risks, dependencies, adoption assumptions and alternatives.
Distinguish time saved from capacity genuinely redeployed and from cost removed; do not treat these as interchangeable financial benefits.
Agree measurement methods and benefit owners before delivery; track investment and realized value at use-case and portfolio levels, with independent validation where appropriate.
Report candidly on adoption, net value, cost and control effectiveness; recommend whether to improve, scale or discontinue initiatives that underperform.

Build, Test And Demonstrate Solutions Personally

Personally design, build and refine selected Finance agents and AI-enabled workflows, especially early prototypes and focused solutions that accelerate learning.
Use Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio hands-on to configure agents, test them with users, assess reliability and improve outputs based on feedback.
Use AI tools regularly in professional work to improve analysis, research, drafting and workflow execution, applying appropriate review and data-handling requirements.
Turn Finance problems into working demonstrations; assess limitations and costs, and decide whether a solution should stop, improve or enter the approved production route.
Stay close enough to delivery to challenge designs, troubleshoot barriers and coach builders, without being the sole developer of enterprise-scale products; partner with Digital and IT on supported deployment.

Establish Practical, Responsible Governance

Translate enterprise AI policy and standards into a Finance operating model covering ownership, intake, risk assessment, testing, approvals, human oversight, monitoring and lifecycle management.
Partner with Digital, IT, the Chief Digital Officer's'organization, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Legal, Risk and Internal Audit to clarify decision rights and navigate the path from idea to approved production use.
Protect sensitive Finance and client information through appropriate access, validation, traceability and human review before AI outputs inform reporting or decisions.
Work with data and process owners on source quality, definitions and controls; reuse approved enterprise platforms and challenge unnecessary complexity without bypassing security or technology accountabilities.

Deliver Through Partnership And Adoption

Partner with the Financial Systems CoE so initiatives fit ERP, EPM and reporting architecture without creating competing technology roadmaps.
Agree delivery responsibilities with Digital and IT while retaining Finance accountability for business outcomes; redesign workflows with process owners around human decisions, exceptions and controls.
Lead communications, training and feedback to build user confidence; create reusable approaches that can scale across regions while respecting genuine process and risk differences.

Lead a Lean, High-impact Team

Build and coach a small team with commercial judgment, hands-on capability and delivery discipline; mobilize a federated network of Finance champions, process owners and enterprise specialists.
Create a culture of curiosity, constructive challenge, accountability and collaboration, including the confidence to recommend "not AI" when appropriate.
Represent Finance in enterprise AI forums and lead by example as both sponsor and practitioner: demonstrate tools, share what works and acknowledge limitations.

About You

A degree in Finance, Business, Technology, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience, is expected.
Significant experience leading AI, data, automation or digital transformation in a complex organization, with demonstrated outcomes beyond proofs of concept.
Experience navigating architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, data governance and risk requirements without losing sight of business value or delivery pace.
Deeper practical experience with Copilot Cowork or Claude Cowork, including a proven record of deploying agentic workflows and demonstrating value in another organization.
Demonstrated hands-on experience building, testing and deploying AI agents, preferably in Microsoft Copilot Studio, with examples you personally created or materially developed.
Experience in an engineering, professional-services or project-based business; familiarity with enterprise Finance platforms, including Oracle-based environments.
Working knowledge of generative AI, agents, analytics and intelligent automation, sufficient to build focused solutions and challenge complex technical designs.
Strong understanding of Finance processes and decisions, ideally including FP&A, reporting, project or contract performance, working capital and financial controls.
Evidence of moving solutions beyond demonstrations to adoption, changed workflows and measurable business outcomes.
Active, capable use of Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT or Claude in day-to-day professional work, with sound judgment about approved tools, sensitive information and human review.
Proven ability to build investment cases, evaluate total cost and alternatives, establish benefit baselines and demonstrate return on investment.
Exceptional collaboration, executive communication and matrix leadership skills; sound judgment about when to scale, simplify or stop.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career at AtkinsRéalis in Canada.

Enjoy competitive compensation, employee recognition, and a brilliant range of flexible benefits you can tailor to your health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle needs.

Make the most of diverse opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise.

And take advantage of our hybrid working culture and generous time-off policies to balance a fulfilling career with your personal life.

Be rewarded. Find out more.

About AtkinsRéalis

We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
